FIFO eviction bounds retained keys + values to 1 MiB.\nlocal expandedModels, expandedOrder, expandedBytes = {}, {}, 0\nlocal EXPANDED_LIMIT = 1024 * 1024\nlocal function expandModelJSON(fragment)\n    if expandedModels[fragment] then return expandedModels[fragment] end\n    local cache = {}\n    local expand\n    expand = function(text)\n        return (text:gsub(\"%$%{(%d+)%}%$\", function(id)\n            id = tonumber(id)\n            if not cache[id] then cache[id] = expand(MODEL_LIBRARY.pool[id]) end\n            return cache[id]\n        end))\n    end\n    local result = expand(fragment)\n    local bytes = #fragment + #result\n    if bytes <= 65536 then\n        while expandedBytes + bytes > EXPANDED_LIMIT or #expandedOrder >= 128 do\n            local old = table.remove(expandedOrder, 1)\n            expandedBytes = expandedBytes - #old - #expandedModels[old]\n            expandedModels[old] = nil\n        end\n        expandedModels[fragment] = result\n        expandedOrder[#expandedOrder + 1] = fragment\n        expandedBytes = expandedBytes + bytes\n    end\n    return result\nend\n\n-- The radio row on the panel, in display order. `id` is what gets saved with\n-- the object and what CONFIG.sculptMode names.\nlocal SCULPT_MODES = {\n    { id = \"2d\",    label = \"2D\",\n      tooltip = \"No sculpts. Maximum 3D coverage; \" ..\n                \"the stand-ins are named in the chat report (right-click \" ..\n                \"this tool to enable it) so you can swap them before \" ..\n                \"saving the army.\" },\n}\n\n--- Index of a mode id in SCULPT_MODES, or nil if it is not one of them.\nlocal function sculptModeIndex(id)\n    for i, mode in ipairs(SCULPT_MODES) do\n        if mode.id == id then return i end\n    end\n    return nil\nend\n\n-- Current mode. CONFIG.sculptMode is only the default for a fresh copy - a\n-- placed tool restores whatever was picked last (see onSave/onLoad). A\n-- misspelt CONFIG value falls back to the first mode rather than to something\n-- in between: a table full of standees is an obvious mistake, where a mode\n-- that half works is not.\nlocal sculptMode = sculptModeIndex(CONFIG.sculptMode)\n    and CONFIG.sculptMode or SCULPT_MODES[1].id\n\n--- The label to show for the mode in effect, for the chat summary.\nlocal function sculptModeLabel()\n    local mode = SCULPT_MODES[sculptModeIndex(sculptMode) or 1]\n    return mode.label\nend\n\n-- A Sapper in a foxhole uses S3, or its own silhouette if that is already\n-- bigger. Only S1/S2 troopers actually change size.\nlocal FOXHOLE_MIN_SILHOUETTE = 3\n\n-- How many \"not sculpted for this loadout\" lines to name before summarising\n-- the rest. Long enough for a typical list, short enough not to bury the\n-- warnings printed after it.\nlocal SCULPT_REPORT_LIMIT = 12\n\n-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ chat --\n\n-- Whether spawn details go to chat. CONFIG.chatReport is only the default\n-- for a fresh copy - the right-click context menu toggles it, and the choice\n-- is saved with the object (see onSave/onLoad and refreshContextMenu).\nlocal chatReport = CONFIG.chatReport and true or false\n\n-- Chat colours, passed as the colour argument of printToAll and friends -\n-- never written into the text as inline [RRGGBB] tags. An inline tag is\n-- parsed out of the message by TTS's chat renderer, and a token it\n-- half-recognises corrupts more than its own line: the old summary ended in\n-- \"[2D]\" (the sculpt-mode label in brackets), which TTS swallowed as a\n-- truncated colour tag - and while that line was on screen, other coloured\n-- lines sharing the chat window rendered nearly black. The Infinity mod's\n-- dice roller became unreadable until the summary scrolled out of view.\n-- Colour-by-argument puts no tags in the text, so there is nothing to eat.\nlocal CHAT = {\n    header = { r = 0.00, g = 0.69, b = 0.95 },   -- the list being spawned\n    good   = { r = 0.67, g = 1.00, b = 0.67 },   -- spawn summary\n    note   = { r = 0.67, g = 0.80, b = 1.00 },   -- hidden-info count\n    detail = { r = 0.80, g = 0.80, b = 0.87 },   -- sculpt shortfall list\n    stale  = { r = 1.00, g = 0.67, b = 0.33 },   -- N4-era stats warning\n    warn   = { r = 1.00, g = 0.80, b = 0.40 },   -- entries with no model\n    error  = { r = 1.00, g = 0.50, b = 0.50 },   -- something failed outright\n}\n\n--- Informational chat, silenced unless the chat report is enabled.\nlocal function report(message, tint)\n    if chatReport then printToAll(message, tint) end\nend\n\n--- Send a message to one player when possible, falling back to everyone.\n--- Used for anything that touches hidden information - which trooper is the\n--- LT is exactly what an opponent should not read in the chat log.\nlocal function printToPlayer(message, playerColor, tint)\n    if playerColor and Player[playerColor] and Player[playerColor].seated then\n        printToColor(message, playerColor, tint)\n    else\n        printToAll(message, tint)\n    end\nend\n\n--- The on-screen version of the same courtesy, for errors: the player who\n--- pressed the button needs to see them, the opponent does not.\nlocal function broadcastToPlayer(message, playerColor, tint)\n    if playerColor and Player[playerColor] and Player[playerColor].seated then\n        broadcastToColor(message, playerColor, tint)\n    else\n        broadcastToAll(message, tint)\n    end\nend\n\n-- ------------------------------------------------------------- utilities --\n\nlocal B64 = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"\nlocal B64_LOOKUP = {}\nfor i = 1, #B64 do B64_LOOKUP[B64:sub(i, i)] = i - 1 end\n\n--- Decode base64 into an array of byte values. Tolerates the url-safe\n--- alphabet, missing padding and embedded whitespace.\nlocal function base64Decode(input)\n    input = input:gsub(\"%s\", \"\"):gsub(\"%-\", \"+\"):gsub(\"_\", \"/\"):gsub(\"=\", \"\")\n    local bytes, acc, bits = {}, 0, 0\n    for i = 1, #input do\n        local ch = input:sub(i, i)\n        local val = B64_LOOKUP[ch]\n        if val == nil then\n            return nil, \"invalid base64 character '\" .. ch .. \"' at position \" .. i\n        end\n        acc = acc * 64 + val\n        bits = bits + 6\n        if bits >= 8 then\n            bits = bits - 8\n            local divisor = 2 ^ bits\n            local byte = math.floor(acc / divisor)\n            acc = acc - byte * divisor\n            bytes[#bytes + 1] = byte\n        end\n    end\n    return bytes\nend\n\nlocal function uriUnescape(str)\n    return (str:gsub(\"%%(%x%x)\", function(hex)\n        return string.char(tonumber(hex, 16))\n    end))\nend\n\n-- --------------------------------------------------------- byte reader ----\n\nlocal Reader = {}\nReader.__index = Reader\n\nfunction Reader.new(bytes)\n    return setmetatable({ bytes = bytes, pos = 1 }, Reader)\nend\n\nfunction Reader:remaining()\n    return #self.bytes - self.pos + 1\nend\n\nfunction Reader:byte()\n    if self.pos > #self.bytes then\n        error(\"army code ended unexpectedly at byte \" .. self.pos, 0)\n    end\n    local value = self.bytes[self.pos]\n    self.pos = self.pos + 1\n    return value\nend\n\nfunction Reader:u16()\n    local a = self:byte()\n    return a * 256 + self:byte()\nend\n\nfunction Reader:u32()\n    local a = self:u16()\n    return a * 65536 + self:u16()\nend\n\n--- js-binary uint: the top bits of the first byte say how wide the value is.\n---   0xxxxxxx           1 byte   0 .. 127\n---   10xxxxxx xxxxxxxx  2 bytes  0 .. 16383      (BE u16 - 0x8000)\n---   110xxxxx ...       4 bytes  0 .. 2^29 - 1   (BE u32 - 0xC0000000)\n---   111xxxxx ... u32   8 bytes  up to 2^53 - 1\nfunction Reader:uint()\n    local first = self.bytes[self.pos]\n    if first == nil then\n        error(\"army code ended unexpectedly at byte \" .. self.pos, 0)\n    end\n    if first < 0x80 then\n        self.pos = self.pos + 1\n        return first\n    elseif first < 0xC0 then\n        return self:u16() - 0x8000\n    elseif first < 0xE0 then\n        return self:u32() - 0xC0000000\n    end\n    local hi = self:u32() - 0xE0000000\n    return hi * 4294967296 + self:u32()\nend\n\n--- js-binary boolean: one byte, and anything but 0/1 is an error. That\n--- strictness is what makes trial-parsing under the wrong schema fail fast.\nfunction Reader:boolean()\n    local value = self:byte()\n    if value > 1 then\n        error(string.format(\"invalid boolean 0x%02X at byte %d\",\n            value, self.pos - 1), 0)\n    end\n    return value == 1\nend\n\nfunction Reader:str(length)\n    if self.pos + length - 1 > #self.bytes then\n        error(string.format(\n            \"string of %d bytes at byte %d overruns the code\", length, self.pos), 0)\n    end\n    local out = {}\n    for i = 1, length do out[i] = string.char(self:byte()) end\n    return table.concat(out)\nend\n\n-- ------------------------------------------------------ army code decode --\n\n--- ARMY writes the share code with the js-binary schema serialiser: a schema\n--- fixes the field order and the encoder writes the list positionally, with\n--- no field names, no version byte and no terminators. The three schemas\n--- below are ARMY's own, copied verbatim from its bundle on 2026-09-02 (see\n--- tools/armycode.py, the reference these are tested against, and\n--- tools/check_army_update.py, which diffs them against the live app).\n---\n--- Wire encoding:\n---   uint      see Reader:uint\n---   string    uint byte-length, then UTF-8 bytes\n---   json      a string holding JSON text (kept as text here)\n---   boolean   one byte, 0 or 1\n---   object    its fields back to back, in schema order\n---   \"name?\"   optional field: one boolean byte (present?), then the value\n---   array     uint count, then the elements back to back\n---\n--- Schema notation used here: a primitive is its type name; an array is\n--- { array = T }; an object is { fields = { { \"name\", T }, ... } } where a\n--- name ending in \"?\" marks an optional field.\nlocal function ARR(t) return { array = t } end\n-- Fields are given positionally; a nil slot (a field a schema does not have)\n-- is skipped, which a plain table constructor would not do reliably.\nlocal function OBJ(...)\n    local fields = {}\n    for i = 1, select(\"#\", ...) do\n        local f = select(i, ...)\n        if f ~= nil then fields[#fields + 1] = f end\n    end\n    return { fields = fields }\nend\n\nlocal SCHEMA_ITEM = OBJ({ \"id\", \"uint\" }, { \"q?\", \"uint\" }, { \"extras?\", ARR(\"uint\") })\nlocal SCHEMA_SPEC_ENTRY = OBJ(\n    { \"id\", \"uint\" }, { \"q?\", \"uint\" }, { \"extras?\", ARR(\"uint\") },\n    { \"skills?\", ARR(SCHEMA_ITEM) }, { \"equips?\", ARR(SCHEMA_ITEM) },\n    { \"weapons?\", ARR(SCHEMA_ITEM) })\nlocal SCHEMA_SPECOPS = OBJ(\n    { \"skills\", ARR(SCHEMA_SPEC_ENTRY) },\n    { \"equip\", ARR(SCHEMA_SPEC_ENTRY) },\n    { \"weapons\", ARR(SCHEMA_SPEC_ENTRY) },\n    { \"attributes\", OBJ(\n        { \"bs\", \"uint\" }, { \"bts\", \"uint\" }, { \"cc\", \"uint\" }, { \"ph\", \"uint\" },\n        { \"w?\", \"uint\" }, { \"str?\", \"uint\" }, { \"wip\", \"uint\" }, { \"arm\", \"uint\" }) })\n\nlocal function schemaList(groupFields, optionFields)\n    return OBJ(\n        { \"faction\", \"uint\" }, { \"factionSlug\", \"string\" }, { \"name\", \"string\" },\n        { \"points\", \"uint\" },\n        { \"groups\", ARR(OBJ(\n            { \"id\", \"uint\" },\n            groupFields,\n            { \"options\", ARR(OBJ(\n                { \"id\", \"uint\" }, { \"unit\", \"uint\" }, { \"profileGroup\", \"uint\" },\n                { \"option\", \"uint\" },\n                { \"specops?\", SCHEMA_SPECOPS },\n                optionFields)) })) })\nend\n\n-- Fields that only exist from a given schema on; nil slots are skipped.\nlocal SCHEMAS = {\n    [1] = schemaList(nil, nil),\n    [2] = schemaList({ \"reinf?\", \"boolean\" }, nil),\n    [3] = schemaList({ \"reinf?\", \"boolean\" },\n                     { \"spectables?\", OBJ({ \"items\", ARR(OBJ({ \"attrs\", \"json\" })) }) }),\n}\n-- Newest first, exactly as ARMY tries them.\nlocal SCHEMA_ORDER = { 3, 2, 1 }\n\n-- Loud limits so a misparse fails fast instead of reading a huge \"array\".\nlocal MAX_ARRAY, MAX_STRING = 4096, 65536\n\nlocal function readSchema(spec, r, path)\n    if type(spec) == \"string\" then\n        if spec == \"uint\" then\n            return r:uint()\n        elseif spec == \"string\" or spec == \"json\" then\n            local length = r:uint()\n            if length > MAX_STRING then\n                error(string.format(\"implausible %s length %d at %s\",\n                    spec, length, path), 0)\n            end\n            return r:str(length)\n        elseif spec == \"boolean\" then\n            return r:boolean()\n        end\n        error(\"unknown primitive type \" .. tostring(spec) .. \" at \" .. path, 0)\n    elseif spec.array then\n        local count = r:uint()\n        if count > MAX_ARRAY then\n            error(string.format(\"implausible array length %d at %s\", count, path), 0)\n        end\n        local out = {}\n        for i = 1, count do\n            out[i] = readSchema(spec.array, r, path .. \"[\" .. i .. \"]\")\n        end\n        return out\n    end\n    local out = {}\n    for _, f in ipairs(spec.fields) do\n        local name, sub = f[1], f[2]\n        local optional = name:sub(-1) == \"?\"\n        if optional then name = name:sub(1, -2) end\n        if not optional or r:boolean() then\n            out[name] = readSchema(sub, r, path .. \".\" .. name)\n        end\n    end\n    return out\nend\n\n--- Parse the whole buffer under one schema. Returns the army table; the\n--- number of unread bytes is left in army.trailingBytes for the caller.\nlocal function decodeBytes(bytes, schema)\n    local r = Reader.new(bytes)\n    local raw = readSchema(SCHEMAS[schema], r, \"list\")\n\n    if #raw.groups > 64 then\n        error(\"implausible combat group count (\" .. #raw.groups ..\n              \") - this does not look like an ARMY list code\", 0)\n    end\n\n    local army = {\n        schema        = schema,\n        sectoral      = raw.faction,\n        factionName   = raw.factionSlug,\n        armyName      = raw.name,\n        maxPoints     = raw.points,\n        groups        = {},\n        trailingBytes = r:remaining(),\n    }\n    for _, g in ipairs(raw.groups) do\n        if #g.options > 256 then\n            error(\"implausible combat group size (\" .. #g.options .. \")\", 0)\n        end\n        local group = { number = g.id, reinf = g.reinf, members = {} }\n        for _, o in ipairs(g.options) do\n            group.members[#group.members + 1] = {\n                id         = o.id,\n                unit       = o.unit,\n                group      = o.profileGroup,\n                option     = o.option,\n                specops    = o.specops,\n                spectables = o.spectables,\n            }\n        end\n        army.groups[#army.groups + 1] = group\n    end\n    if army.trailingBytes > 0 then\n        army.warning = string.format(\n            \"%d unread byte(s) after the list - ARMY may have extended its \" ..\n            \"code format; the tool's decoder may need updating \" ..\n            \"(tools/check_army_update.py)\", army.trailingBytes)\n    end\n    return army\nend\n\n--- Decode a share code. Returns (army, nil) or (nil, errorMessage).\n--- ARMY sometimes hands the code out URI-escaped inside a share link, so the\n--- raw text and its unescaped form are both tried before giving up - and each\n--- of those is tried under every known schema, newest first. A parse that\n--- consumes the buffer exactly wins; otherwise the newest clean parse is\n--- accepted with army.warning set, which is what ARMY itself would do (its\n--- decoder never checks for trailing data).\nlocal function decodeArmyCode(code)\n    if code == nil or code:match(\"^%s*$\") then\n        return nil, \"no army code entered\"\n    end\n\n    -- ARMY's share button hands out https://.../army/list/<code>; take the\n    -- code off the end of a pasted link.\n    code = code:gsub(\"^%s+\", \"\"):gsub(\"%s+$\", \"\")\n    if code:find(\"://\", 1, true) then\n        code = code:gsub(\"/+$\", \"\"):match(\"([^/]*)$\")\n    end\n\n    local candidates = { code }\n    local unescaped = uriUnescape(code)\n    if unescaped ~= code then candidates[#candidates + 1] = unescaped end\n\n    local lastError = \"code is not valid base64\"\n    for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do\n        local bytes, b64err = base64Decode(candidate)\n        if not bytes then\n            lastError = b64err\n        elseif #bytes == 0 then\n            lastError = \"code decoded to no data\"\n        else\n            local fallback, messages = nil, {}\n            for _, schema in ipairs(SCHEMA_ORDER) do\n                local ok, result = pcall(decodeBytes, bytes, schema)\n                if ok then\n                    if result.trailingBytes == 0 then return result, nil end\n                    fallback = fallback or result\n                else\n                    messages[#messages + 1] = \"schema \" .. schema .. \": \" ..\n                        tostring(result)\n                end\n            end\n            if fallback then return fallback, nil end\n            lastError = \"could not parse the code under any known ARMY \" ..\n                \"format - ARMY may have changed it (see \" ..\n                \"tools/check_army_update.py). \" .. table.concat(messages, \"; \")\n        end\n    end\n\n    return nil, lastError\nend\n\n-- ------------------------------------------------------------ bag index --\n\n--- Pull the five trailing hex id tags out of a model description.\nlocal function parseIdTags(description)\n    if not description or description == \"\" then return nil end\n    local tags = {}\n    for hex in string.gmatch(description, \"%[(%x%x%x%x%x%x)%]%[%-%]\") do\n        tags[#tags + 1] = tonumber(hex, 16)\n    end\n    local n = #tags\n    if n < 5 then return nil end\n    return {\n        sectoral = tags[n - 4],\n        unit     = tags[n - 3],\n        group    = tags[n - 2],\n        profile  = tags[n - 1],\n        option   = tags[n],\n    }\nend\n\n--- A model's full identity, used to find it again inside its bag.\n---\n--- Bag contents cannot be addressed by GUID here: every tagged model in the\n--- workshop mod is stored with an empty GUID, so getObjects() reports \"\" for\n--- all 4375 of them. The five ID tags are what actually identify a model.\nlocal function signature(ids)\n    return string.format(\"%d/%d/%d/%d/%d\", ids.sectoral, ids.unit, ids.group,\n                                           ids.profile, ids.option)\nend\n\n--- Pull the silhouette size out of a model's statline, e.g. \"[B]S[/B]: 2\".\n--- Returned as a string so it can key SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES directly.\nlocal function parseSilhouette(description)\n    if not description then return nil end\n    return string.match(description, \"%[[Bb]%]S%[/[Bb]%]:%s*(%d+)\")\nend\n\n--- Sapper troopers can dig in, which swaps them to the foxhole silhouette.\nlocal function hasSapper(description)\n    if not description then return false end\n    return string.find(string.lower(description), \"sapper\", 1, true) ~= nil\nend\n\n--- The silhouette a Sapper occupies once dug in, as a string key.\nlocal function foxholeSilhouette(silhouette)\n    local own = tonumber(silhouette)\n    if not own then return nil end\n    if own < FOXHOLE_MIN_SILHOUETTE then own = FOXHOLE_MIN_SILHOUETTE end\n    return tostring(own)\nend\n\nlocal modelIndex = nil    -- \"unit/group/option\" -> { candidate, ... }\nlocal unitIndex = nil     -- \"unit/group\"        -> { candidate, ... }\nlocal indexedCount = 0\nlocal indexedBags = 0\n\n--- Always format lookup keys through %d. TTS's Lua keeps every number as a\n--- double, so plain concatenation could render the same id differently on the\n--- index side and the army-code side and silently miss the match.\nlocal function lookupKey(unit, group, option)\n    return string.format(\"%d/%d/%d\", unit, group, option)\nend\n\n--- The same key without the option, for finding a sibling loadout's sculpt.\nlocal function unitKey(unit, group)\n    return string.format(\"%d/%d\", unit, group)\nend\n\n-- Static snapshot indexes are built once. Live bags retain parsed candidates\n-- while their metadata is unchanged; scanning metadata still detects added,\n-- removed, renamed and edited entries without events or background polling.\nlocal embeddedIndex, embeddedUnitIndex, embeddedCount, embeddedBags\nlocal bagCache, indexedLiveBags = {}, nil\nlocal jsonCache = {}      -- bag/signature -> captured live object JSON\n\nlocal function addCandidate(index, siblings, candidate)\n    local key, uKey = candidate.key, candidate.unitKey\n    index[key] = index[key] or {}\n    index[key][#index[key] + 1] = candidate\n    siblings[uKey] = siblings[uKey] or {}\n    siblings[uKey][#siblings[uKey] + 1] = candidate\nend\n\nlocal function sameBagEntries(previous, contents)\n    if not previous or #previous.entries ~= #contents then return false end\n    for i, entry in ipairs(contents) do\n        local old = previous.entries[i]\n        if old.description ~= entry.description or old.nickname ~= entry.nickname\n                or old.name ~= entry.name or old.template ~= entry.template\n                or old.guid ~= entry.guid then return false end\n    end\n    return true\nend\n\nlocal function indexBag(guid, contents)\n    local record = {entries={}, candidates={}}\n    local n5, n4 = 0, 0\n    for i, entry in ipairs(contents) do\n        -- Copy fields so changes to an existing metadata table are detectable.\n        record.entries[i] = {description=entry.description, nickname=entry.nickname,\n            name=entry.name, template=entry.template, guid=entry.guid}\n        local d = entry.description or \"\"\n        if d:find(\"%[[Bb]%]V%[/[Bb]%]\") then n5 = n5 + 1\n        elseif d:find(\"%[[Bb]%]W%[/[Bb]%]\") then n4 = n4 + 1 end\n    end\n    -- STR-only profiles inherit their bag's rules edition.\n    local edition = n5 > n4 and 5 or (n4 > n5 and 4 or 0)\n    for _, entry in ipairs(contents) do\n        local ids = parseIdTags(entry.description)\n        if ids then\n            record.candidates[#record.candidates + 1] = {\n                key=lookupKey(ids.unit, ids.group, ids.option),\n                unitKey=unitKey(ids.unit, ids.group), sig=signature(ids),\n                bag=guid, template=entry.template, edition=edition,\n                sectoral=ids.sectoral, profile=ids.profile, option=ids.option,\n                nickname=entry.nickname or entry.name or \"?\",\n                silhouette=parseSilhouette(entry.description),\n                sapper=hasSapper(entry.description),\n            }\n        end\n    end\n    return record\nend\n\nlocal function buildIndex()\n    if not embeddedIndex then\n        embeddedIndex, embeddedUnitIndex, embeddedCount, embeddedBags = {}, {}, 0, 0\n        local bags = {}\n        for _, row in ipairs(MODEL_LIBRARY and MODEL_LIBRARY.rows or {}) do\n            local candidate = {\n                key=row[1], unitKey=row[2], sig=row[3], bag=row[4],\n                edition=row[5], sectoral=row[6], profile=row[7], option=row[8],\n                nickname=row[9], silhouette=row[10] or nil,\n                sapper=row[11], template=row[12],\n            }\n            addCandidate(embeddedIndex, embeddedUnitIndex, candidate)\n            embeddedCount = embeddedCount + 1\n            bags[candidate.bag] = true\n        end\n        for _ in pairs(bags) do embeddedBags = embeddedBags + 1 end\n    end\n\n    local live, retained = {}, {}\n    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do\n        -- Infinite bags cannot be queried and hold no tagged troopers.\n        if obj.type == \"Bag\" then\n            local ok, contents = pcall(function() return obj.getObjects() end)\n            if ok and type(contents) == \"table\" then\n                local guid = obj.getGUID()\n                local record = bagCache[guid]\n                if not sameBagEntries(record, contents) then\n                    record = indexBag(guid, contents)\n                    -- Captured live JSON must not outlive changed bag metadata.\n                    jsonCache = {}\n                end\n                retained[guid] = record\n                if #record.candidates > 0 then live[#live + 1] = record end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    bagCache = retained -- forget removed/inaccessible bags\n    local same = indexedLiveBags and #live == #indexedLiveBags\n    if same then\n        for i, record in ipairs(live) do\n            if record ~= indexedLiveBags[i] then same = false; break end\n        end\n    end\n    if same then return indexedCount end\n    indexedLiveBags = live\n    jsonCache = {}\n    indexedCount, indexedBags = embeddedCount, embeddedBags\n    modelIndex, unitIndex = embeddedIndex, embeddedUnitIndex\n    if #live > 0 then\n        -- Build live buckets first, preserving the original donor tie order.\n        -- Only extended buckets need their own arrays; all others share the\n        -- static index, which is never mutated by adding/removing live bags.\n        modelIndex, unitIndex = {}, {}\n        for _, record in ipairs(live) do\n            indexedBags = indexedBags + 1\n            for _, candidate in ipairs(record.candidates) do\n                addCandidate(modelIndex, unitIndex, candidate)\n                indexedCount = indexedCount + 1\n            end\n        end\n        local function mergeEmbedded(index, original)\n            for key, bucket in pairs(original) do\n                if not index[key] then index[key] = bucket\n                else\n                    for _, candidate in ipairs(bucket) do\n                        index[key][#index[key] + 1] = candidate\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n        end\n        mergeEmbedded(modelIndex, embeddedIndex)\n        mergeEmbedded(unitIndex, embeddedUnitIndex)\n    end\n    return indexedCount\nend\n\n--- Rank candidates. Rules freshness dominates everything else: spawning an\n--- N4-era profile means wrong stats on the table, which is worse than a\n--- mismatched faction tint. Within one edition, exact sectoral beats same\n--- faction family beats anything.\nlocal function candidateScore(candidate, sectoral)\n    local penalty\n    if candidate.edition == 5 then\n        penalty = 0\n    elseif candidate.edition == 4 then\n        penalty = 20\n    else\n        penalty = 10          -- unknown edition: behind N5, ahead of known N4\n    end\n\n    if candidate.sectoral == sectoral then\n        return penalty\n    elseif math.floor(candidate.sectoral / 100) == math.floor(sectoral / 100) then\n        return penalty + 1\n    end\n    return penalty + 2\nend\n\n-- Approved unit/group appearances are independent of sectorial and loadout.\n-- Mercenary aliases fold by 10000; groups separate companions such as Jackbots.\nlocal function approvedSculpt(unit, group, sectoral, profile)\n    local native = unit >= 10000 and unit - 10000 or unit\n    local key = tostring(unit) .. \"/\" .. tostring(group)\n    local nativeKey = tostring(native) .. \"/\" .. tostring(group)\n    if sculptMode == \"force\" then\n        -- One rules form may wear its own model: the Tohaa Team-Ops Heavy is\n        -- an Ectros until its symbiont armour goes inactive.\n        if profile then\n            local form = string.format(\"/p%d\", profile)\n            local own = FORCE_APPROVED_SCULPTS[key .. form]\n                or FORCE_APPROVED_SCULPTS[nativeKey .. form]\n            if own then return own end\n        end\n        local scope = sectoral and (\"f\" .. tostring(math.floor(sectoral / 100)) .. \"/\")\n        local forced = scope and (FORCE_APPROVED_SCULPTS[scope .. key]\n            or FORCE_APPROVED_SCULPTS[scope .. nativeKey])\n        forced = forced or FORCE_APPROVED_SCULPTS[key] or FORCE_APPROVED_SCULPTS[nativeKey]\n        if forced then return forced end\n    end\n    if sectoral then\n        local scope = \"f\" .. tostring(math.floor(sectoral / 100)) .. \"/\"\n        local scoped = APPROVED_SCULPTS[scope .. key] or APPROVED_SCULPTS[scope .. nativeKey]\n        if scoped then return scoped end\n    end\n    return APPROVED_SCULPTS[key] or APPROVED_SCULPTS[nativeKey]\nend\n\n-- Aerial is a rules skill, not Super-Jump or an aircraft-like unit name.\nlocal function flyerSculpt(unit, group)\n    if sculptMode ~= \"force\" then return nil end\n    local native = unit >= 10000 and unit-10000 or unit\n    local base = FLYER_BASE_MM[tostring(native) .. \"/\" .. tostring(group)]\n    local redeye = CUSTOM_SCULPTS[\"1816/1/1\"]\n    if not base or not redeye then return nil end\n    local appearance = JSON.decode(redeye)\n    for _, axis in ipairs({\"scaleX\", \"scaleY\", \"scaleZ\"}) do\n        appearance.Transform[axis] = appearance.Transform[axis] * base / 55\n    end\n    return JSON.encode(appearance)\nend\n\n--- Resolve one list entry to a primary model plus any alternate-profile\n--- models that should become TTS states.\nlocal function resolveMember(member, sectoral)\n    local requestedKey = lookupKey(member.unit, member.group, member.option)\n    local key = lookupKey(member.unit, member.group, member.option)\n    local bucket = modelIndex[key]\n    local remapped = false\n\n    -- Mercenaries hired outside their native faction sit at id+10000 in the\n    -- army code - a Nomads list writes Scarface as unit 10380 - while the mod\n    -- always tags the native id. Fold down when the offset id answers to\n    -- nothing, which for these 49 units is always. Rebound rather than\n    -- mutated, so the caller's table keeps the ids the code actually said.\n    if (not bucket or #bucket == 0) and member.unit >= 10000\n            and not OPTION_REMAP[key] then\n        member = { unit = member.unit - 10000, group = member.group,\n                   option = member.option }\n        key = lookupKey(member.unit, member.group, member.option)\n        bucket = modelIndex[key]\n    end\n\n    -- Hidden-info options (LT, Chain of Command, ...) fall back to the sibling\n    -- option that looks identical on the table.\n    if not bucket or #bucket == 0 then\n        local target = OPTION_REMAP[key]\n        if target then\n            bucket = modelIndex[target]\n            remapped = true\n        end\n    end\n    if not bucket or #bucket == 0 then return nil end\n\n    local best = math.huge\n    for _, candidate in ipairs(bucket) do\n        best = math.min(best, candidateScore(candidate, sectoral))\n    end\n\n    -- Keep the best-scoring candidate for each distinct profile index.\n    local byProfile = {}\n    for _, candidate in ipairs(bucket) do\n        if candidateScore(candidate, sectoral) == best then\n            local current = byProfile[candidate.profile]\n            -- Break ties per profile so a live primary does not suppress\n            -- alternate profiles that exist only in the embedded snapshot.\n            if not current or candidate.sectoral < current.sectoral\n                    or (candidate.sectoral == current.sectoral\n                        and current.template and not candidate.template) then\n                byProfile[candidate.profile] = candidate\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    local profiles = {}\n    for profile in pairs(byProfile) do profiles[#profiles + 1] = profile end\n    table.sort(profiles)\n\n    -- `key` is the id the entry answers to after the mercenary fold, which is\n    -- also how the build-time tables (peripherals, sculpt pack) spell it - so\n    -- it rides along for the caller's own lookups.\n    local resolved = { primary = byProfile[profiles[1]], alternates = {},\n                       remapped = remapped, key = key, approvalSectoral = sectoral,\n                       requestedKey = requestedKey }\n    for i = 2, #profiles do\n        resolved.alternates[#resolved.alternates + 1] = byProfile[profiles[i]]\n    end\n\n    -- Pick a sculpt to borrow. The rules model above comes from whichever bag\n    -- has the current stats; if the same profile also sits in a different bag\n    -- - a community 3D model pack, say - that copy is usually there for its\n    -- mesh, so wear it over the correct rules. Only ever a visual swap.\n    --\n    -- \"2d\" skips the whole business, which is not the same as flattening\n    -- anything: the model still renders however its own rules entry does. It\n    -- just never puts on someone else's mesh.\n    if sculptMode ~= \"2d\" and resolved.primary then\n        local rulesBag = resolved.primary.bag\n        local rulesEdition = resolved.primary.edition\n        for _, candidate in ipairs(bucket) do\n            -- Must be a different mod, not just a different bag. One mod\n            -- lists the same trooper in several faction bags with identical\n            -- meshes, and borrowing across those is a wasted bag round trip\n            -- for no visual change. Edition is what distinguishes the mods.\n            if candidate.bag ~= rulesBag\n                    and candidate.edition ~= rulesEdition\n                    and candidate.profile == resolved.primary.profile then\n                resolved.sculpt = candidate\n                break\n            end\n        end\n\n        -- Nothing sculpted this exact loadout. Fall back to a sibling option\n        -- of the same trooper: same unit, same profile group, different gun.\n        -- Prefer the nearest option number from the same sectoral, which in\n        -- practice picks the closest pose rather than an arbitrary one.\n        if not resolved.sculpt and CONFIG.proxySculpts then\n            local siblings = unitIndex[unitKey(member.unit, member.group)]\n            local bestProxy, bestRank = nil, math.huge\n            for _, candidate in ipairs(siblings or {}) do\n                if candidate.bag ~= rulesBag\n                        and candidate.edition ~= rulesEdition\n                        and candidate.option ~= member.option then\n                    local rank = math.abs(candidate.option - member.option)\n                    if candidate.sectoral ~= sectoral then\n                        rank = rank + 100\n                    end\n                    if rank < bestRank then\n                        bestRank, bestProxy = rank, candidate\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n            if bestProxy then\n                resolved.sculpt = bestProxy\n                resolved.sculptProxy = true\n            end\n        end\n\n        -- Last resort, and the usual one: the sculpt pack we carry. A live bag\n        -- still wins, because a loaded mod is by definition current while the\n        -- pack is a snapshot - but the pack covers far more profiles, and it\n        -- needs no bag round trip at all.\n        if not resolved.sculpt then\n            -- A hidden-info option has no model of its own in either mod, so\n            -- the pack knows it under the public twin's key too.\n            local packKey = key\n            if not SCULPT_MAP[packKey] and remapped and OPTION_REMAP[key] then\n                packKey = OPTION_REMAP[key]\n            end\n            local packed = SCULPT_MAP[packKey]\n            if packed and SCULPT_APPEARANCES[packed] then\n                -- A pack record is only as good as what it depicts. A stand-in\n                -- is a different trooper, so \"match\" turns it down and leaves\n                -- the model on its own standee; only \"force\" wears it.\n                local standIn = SCULPT_STANDIN[packKey]\n                local inexact = SCULPT_MATCH[packKey]\n                local allowed\n                if standIn then\n                    allowed = sculptMode == \"force\"\n                elseif inexact then\n                    allowed = CONFIG.proxySculpts\n                else\n                    allowed = true\n                end\n                if allowed then\n                    resolved.packSculpt = packed\n                    if standIn then\n                        resolved.standIn =\n                            SCULPT_STANDIN_NAMES[standIn] or \"another trooper\"\n                    elseif inexact then\n                        resolved.packInexact = true\n                    end\n                elseif standIn then\n                    -- Refused, but worth saying so: \"no sculpt exists\" and \"a\n                    -- sculpt exists and this mode declined it\" are different\n                    -- answers, and only one of them is fixed by a button.\n                    resolved.standInRefused =\n                        SCULPT_STANDIN_NAMES[standIn] or \"another trooper\"\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- User-created sculpts override the community pack only in 3D modes.\n    if sculptMode ~= \"2d\" then\n        local custom = approvedSculpt(member.unit, member.group, sectoral,\n                                      resolved.primary.profile) or CUSTOM_SCULPTS[key]\n        if not custom and remapped then custom = CUSTOM_SCULPTS[OPTION_REMAP[key]] end\n        if not custom and not resolved.sculpt\n                and (not resolved.packSculpt or resolved.standIn) then\n            custom = flyerSculpt(member.unit, member.group)\n            resolved.flyerFallback = custom ~= nil\n        end\n        if custom then\n            resolved.customSculpt = custom\n            resolved.sculpt, resolved.packSculpt = nil, nil\n            resolved.sculptProxy, resolved.packInexact = nil, nil\n            resolved.standIn, resolved.standInRefused = nil, nil\n        end\n    end\n    return resolved\nend\n\n-- --------------------------------------------------- serialised model IO --\n\n--- Take a model out of its bag, capture its JSON, and put it straight back.\n---\n--- The model is located by its ID signature rather than by GUID, because every\n--- tagged model in the mod carries an empty GUID. That leaves taking by index,\n--- and putObject appends the model to the end of the bag rather than restoring\n--- its old slot - so the listing is re-read immediately before each take\n--- instead of being cached across takes.\nlocal function withModelJSON(candidate, done)\n    local originalDone=done\n    local completed=false\n    local timer\n    local function complete(json)\n        if completed then return end\n        completed=true\n        if timer and Wait.stop then Wait.stop(timer) end\n        originalDone(json)\n    end\n    done=complete\n    if candidate.template then return done(expandModelJSON(candidate.template)) end\n    local cacheKey = candidate.bag .. \":\" .. candidate.sig\n    local cached = jsonCache[cacheKey]\n    if cached then return done(cached) end\n\n    local bag = getObjectFromGUID(candidate.bag)\n    if not bag then return done(nil) end\n\n    local ok, contents = pcall(function() return bag.getObjects() end)\n    if not ok or type(contents) ~= \"table\" then return done(nil) end\n\n    local slot = nil\n    for _, entry in ipairs(contents) do\n        local ids = parseIdTags(entry.description)\n        if ids and signature(ids) == candidate.sig then\n            slot = entry.index\n            break\n        end\n    end\n    if slot == nil then return done(nil) end\n\n    if Wait.time then timer=Wait.time(function() complete(nil) end,30) end\n    bag.takeObject({\n        index             = slot,\n        position          = CONFIG.stagingPos,\n        smooth            = false,\n        callback_function = function(taken)\n            if completed then\n                if taken and getObjectFromGUID(candidate.bag)==bag then bag.putObject(taken) end\n                return\n            end\n            local ok,json=pcall(function() return taken and taken.getJSON() end)\n            if not ok or not json then complete(nil);return end\n            jsonCache[cacheKey] = json\n            -- Give TTS a frame to finish spawning before returning it.\n            Wait.frames(function()\n                if completed then return end\n                local returned=pcall(function()\n                    if getObjectFromGUID(candidate.bag)==bag then bag.putObject(taken) end\n                end)\n                done(returned and json or nil)\n            end, 1)\n        end,\n    })\nend\n\n-- ------------------------------------------------------------- job queue --\n\n-- Bag takes are asynchronous, so model preparation runs strictly one at a\n-- time. Each job receives a continuation to call when it is finished.\nlocal queue, queueRunning = {}, false\nlocal queueFailed, queueGeneration = false, 0\nlocal spawnBusy, spawnPlayer = false, nil\n\nlocal function finishSpawn()\n    if spawnBusy then\n        spawnBusy = false\n        self.editButton({index=0, label=\"SPAWN ARMY\"})\n    end\nend\n\nlocal function failSpawn(err)\n    queueFailed, queueGeneration = true, queueGeneration + 1\n    queue, queueRunning = {}, false\n    finishSpawn()\n    broadcastToPlayer(\"Army spawn stopped: \" .. tostring(err), spawnPlayer, CHAT.error)\nend\n\nlocal function pumpQueue()\n    if #queue == 0 then\n        queueRunning = false\n        finishSpawn()\n        return\n    end\n    queueRunning = true\n    local job = table.remove(queue, 1)\n    local generation = queueGeneration\n    local ok, err = pcall(job, function()\n        Wait.frames(function()\n            if generation == queueGeneration then pumpQueue() end\n        end, 1)\n    end)\n    if not ok then failSpawn(err) end\nend\n\nlocal function enqueue(job)\n    if queueFailed then return end\n    queue[#queue + 1] = job\n    if not queueRunning then pumpQueue() end\nend\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- layout --\n\n--- Distance from the tool's centre to its first row of models. Derived from\n--- the tool's actual footprint so that resizing the panel can never leave\n--- models landing on top of it. getBounds is world-axis-aligned, so a rotated\n--- tool reports a larger box - erring towards more clearance, which is the\n--- safe direction.\nlocal function firstRowOffset()\n    local depth\n    local ok, bounds = pcall(function() return self.getBounds() end)\n    if ok and bounds and bounds.size and bounds.size.z then\n        depth = bounds.size.z\n    else\n        depth = self.getScale().z\n    end\n    return depth / 2 + CONFIG.frontClearance\nend\n\n--- World position for a model in a side-by-side group layout: each combat\n--- group gets its own block of columns, blocks sit left to right in list\n--- order, and rows grow away from the spawner.\nlocal function layoutPosition(groupSlot, numGroups, rowIndex, colIndex, frontGap, layout)\n    local origin  = layout and layout.origin or self.getPosition()\n    local right   = layout and layout.right or self.getTransformRight()\n    local forward = layout and layout.forward or self.getTransformForward()\n\n    local blockWidth = CONFIG.perRow * CONFIG.spacingX\n    local totalWidth = numGroups * blockWidth\n                       + (numGroups - 1) * CONFIG.groupGapX\n    local blockCentre = -totalWidth / 2\n                        + (groupSlot - 1) * (blockWidth + CONFIG.groupGapX)\n                        + blockWidth / 2\n\n    local offsetX = blockCentre\n                    + (colIndex - (CONFIG.perRow - 1) / 2) * CONFIG.spacingX\n    local offsetZ = frontGap + rowIndex * CONFIG.spacingZ\n\n    return {\n        x = origin.x + right.x * offsetX + forward.x * offsetZ,\n        y = origin.y + CONFIG.spawnHeight,\n        z = origin.z + right.z * offsetX + forward.z * offsetZ,\n    }\nend\n\n-- Place the neutral HVT in the clear aisle between the first two groups.\n-- A one-group army uses the same clearance immediately beside its block.\nlocal function hvtPosition(numGroups, frontGap, layout)\n    local left = layoutPosition(1, numGroups, 0, CONFIG.perRow - 1, frontGap, layout)\n    local right\n    if numGroups >= 2 then\n        right = layoutPosition(2, numGroups, 0, 0, frontGap, layout)\n    else\n        local axis = layout and layout.right or self.getTransformRight()\n        local clearance = CONFIG.spacingX + CONFIG.groupGapX\n        right = {x=left.x + axis.x*clearance, y=left.y,\n                 z=left.z + axis.z*clearance}\n    end\n    return {x=(left.x+right.x)/2, y=left.y, z=(left.z+right.z)/2}\nend\n\nlocal function hvtPool()\n    return sculptMode == \"2d\" and HVT_STANDEES or HVT_MODELS\nend\n\nlocal function spawnRandomHVT(numGroups, frontGap, layout, pool)\n    pool = pool or hvtPool()\n    if #pool == 0 then return end\n    local json = pool[math.random(#pool)]\n    spawnObjectJSON({json=json, position=hvtPosition(numGroups, frontGap, layout),\n                     rotation={0,(layout and layout.yaw or self.getRotation().y)+180,0}})\nend\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- spawning --\n\n--- Build the final object JSON.\n---\n--- The workshop models already carry states of their own - silhouettes, camo\n--- markers, and transformation forms like SU-JIAN COMBAT FORM or DOG-WARRIOR\n--- FORM. Those must survive: anything we add is appended after the existing\n--- states, never written over them.\n---\n--- On top of that, roughly 15% of models are camo troopers that ship with only\n--- their marker state and no plain silhouette to reveal into, so we add the one\n--- matching their S value when it is absent.\n--- Collect the silhouette sizes an existing state already puts on the table.\n--- \"Silhouette 3\" covers S3. Marker states carry their size in the name -\n--- \"Camouflage (-3) S2\", \"Camouflage (-6) S6\" - and impersonation markers\n--- (IMP-1, IMP-2) are S2 templates. A unit whose marker state already matches\n--- its own S value needs no extra plain silhouette.\nlocal function addCoveredSizes(nickname, covered)\n    if not nickname then return end\n    for size in nickname:gmatch(\"Silhouette (%d+)\") do\n        covered[size] = true\n    end\n    for size in nickname:gmatch(\"%f[%a]S(%d+)\") do\n        covered[size] = true\n    end\n    if nickname:find(\"^IMP%-\") then\n        covered[\"2\"] = true\n    end\nend\n\n--- Strip the faction colour tags off a nickname so two spellings of the same\n--- model compare equal.\nlocal function bareName(nickname)\n    if not nickname then return \"\" end\n    return (nickname:gsub(\"%[%x%x%x%x%x%x%]\", \"\"):gsub(\"%[%-%]\", \"\"))\nend\n\n-- Everything that decides what an object looks like. TTS picks the renderer\n-- from `Name`, and each renderer reads a different block - a Custom_Model uses\n-- CustomMesh, a Custom_Assetbundle uses CustomAssetbundle - so the whole set\n-- has to move together and any block belonging to the old type has to go. The\n-- 3D miniatures mod is 2464 asset bundles to 52 meshes, so copying CustomMesh\n-- alone silently changed nothing and every borrow stayed a flat standee.\nlocal APPEARANCE_KEYS = {\n    \"CustomMesh\", \"CustomAssetbundle\", \"CustomImage\", \"CustomToken\",\n    \"AttachedDecals\", \"ChildObjects\", \"AltLookAngle\",\n}\n\n--- The URL an object renders from, whichever kind of object it is. Used to\n--- tell two appearances apart without caring which block they live in.\nlocal function appearanceURL(object)\n    if type(object) ~= \"table\" then return nil end\n    return (object.CustomMesh or {}).MeshURL\n        or (object.CustomAssetbundle or {}).AssetbundleURL\n        or (object.CustomImage or {}).ImageURL\nend\n\n--- Put `sculpt`'s appearance onto `object`, leaving its rules, name, states\n--- and description alone. Scale comes along; position and rotation do not,\n--- since the spawner decides those.\nlocal function wearSculpt(object, sculpt)\n    if type(sculpt) ~= \"table\" or not sculpt.Name then return false end\n    if not appearanceURL(sculpt) then return false end\n\n    object.Name = sculpt.Name\n    for _, key in ipairs(APPEARANCE_KEYS) do\n        object[key] = sculpt[key]      -- nil clears a block the new type will not use\n    end\n    if sculpt.Transform then\n        local t = object.Transform or {}\n        t.scaleX = sculpt.Transform.scaleX or t.scaleX\n        t.scaleY = sculpt.Transform.scaleY or t.scaleY\n        t.scaleZ = sculpt.Transform.scaleZ or t.scaleZ\n        object.Transform = t\n    end\n    return true\nend\n\n--- Deep copy a decoded object so a scaled state does not alias the original.\nlocal function deepCopy(value)\n    if type(value) ~= \"table\" then return value end\n    local copy = {}\n    for k, v in pairs(value) do copy[k] = deepCopy(v) end\n    return copy\nend\n\n-- Standardize rules geometry without guessing dimensions of opaque 3D bundles.\n-- N5_GEOMETRY is injected by the builder only when all assets are available.\nlocal function n5CanProne(object)\n    local description = object.Description or \"\"\n    local troopType = description:match(\"%[[Bb]%](.-)%[/[Bb]%]\")\n    if troopType == \"TAG\" or troopType == \"VH\" then return false end\n    local text = description:lower()\n    if text:find(\"%f[%a]aerial%f[%A]\") then return false end\n    if text:find(\"motorcycle\", 1, true)\n            and not (object.Nickname or \"\"):lower():find(\"dismounted\", 1, true) then\n        return false\n    end\n    -- Unknown profiles are not assigned a rules permission by guessing.\n    return troopType == \"LI\" or troopType == \"MI\" or troopType == \"HI\"\n        or troopType == \"SK\" or troopType == \"WB\" or troopType == \"REM\"\nend\n\nlocal function n5Transform(object)\n    local transform = object.Transform or {}\n    transform.scaleX, transform.scaleY, transform.scaleZ = 1, 1, 1\n    object.Transform = transform\nend\n\nlocal function n5Mesh(object, meshURL, colliderURL)\n    object.Name = \"Custom_Model\"\n    object.CustomAssetbundle, object.CustomImage, object.CustomToken = nil, nil, nil\n    object.CustomMesh = object.CustomMesh or {}\n    local mesh = object.CustomMesh\n    mesh.MeshURL, mesh.ColliderURL = meshURL, colliderURL\n    mesh.Convex = true\n    mesh.MaterialIndex = 3\n    mesh.CustomShader = {SpecularColor={r=1,g=1,b=1},\n        SpecularIntensity=0, SpecularSharpness=2, FresnelStrength=0}\n    n5Transform(object)\nend\n\nlocal function n5Template(size, proneAllowed, colour)\n    local spec = N5_GEOMETRY.sizes[size]\n    if not spec then return nil end\n    local template = SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[size] or SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[\"2\"]\n    local state = JSON.decode(template)\n    state.GUID, state.States = nil, nil\n    state.Nickname = \"Silhouette \" .. size\n    state.ColorDiffuse = deepCopy(colour or {r=1,g=1,b=1})\n    state.Description = \"S\" .. size .. \": \" .. spec.diameter .. \" mm base, \"\n        .. spec.height .. \" mm high. \"\n        .. (proneAllowed and \"Flip to show the 3 mm prone footprint.\"\n            or \"This profile cannot go prone.\")\n    n5Mesh(state, spec.mesh, proneAllowed and spec.collider or spec.mesh)\n    state.CustomMesh.TypeIndex = 0 -- keep an intentional flip when picked up\n    state.CustomMesh.DiffuseURL, state.CustomMesh.NormalURL = \"\", \"\"\n    return state\nend\n\nlocal function normalizeN5(object, fallbackSize)\n    local states = object.States or {}\n    local highest = 1\n    local names = {}\n    for key, state in pairs(states) do\n        highest = math.max(highest, tonumber(key) or 1)\n        names[state.Nickname or \"\"] = true\n    end\n    local function add(state)\n        if state and not names[state.Nickname] then\n            highest = highest + 1\n            states[tostring(highest)] = state\n            names[state.Nickname] = true\n        end\n    end\n\n    local forms = {}\n    local function gather(form, fallback)\n        local size = parseSilhouette(form.Description) or fallback\n        if size and N5_GEOMETRY.sizes[size] then\n            forms[size] = forms[size] or {object=form, prone=n5CanProne(form)}\n        end\n    end\n    gather(object, fallbackSize)\n    for _, state in pairs(states) do\n        if parseSilhouette(state.Description) and not (state.Nickname or \"\"):find(\"IN FOXHOLE\",1,true) then\n            gather(state)\n        end\n    end\n    local rootSize = parseSilhouette(object.Description) or fallbackSize\n    local rootCanProne = n5CanProne(object)\n    local markers = {}\n    local function normalize(state, fallback)\n        local name = state.Nickname or \"\"\n        if name:find(\"%- Prone SX$\") then return end\n        local plain = name:match(\"^Silhouette (%d+)$\")\n        local marker = name:find(\"^Camouflage\") or name:find(\"^IMP%-\")\n        local size = plain or (marker and name:match(\"S(%d+)\"))\n            or parseSilhouette(state.Description) or fallback\n        -- IMP keeps its trooper's silhouette, not the original marker's S2.\n        if name:find(\"^IMP%-\") then size = fallback end\n        -- Foxhole changes S; its original rules description still carries normal S.\n        size = name:match(\"IN FOXHOLE %(S(%d+)%)\") or size\n        local spec = size and N5_GEOMETRY.sizes[size]\n        if not spec then return end\n        local canProne = (marker and rootCanProne) or (forms[size] and forms[size].prone) or false\n        if plain or marker then\n            n5Mesh(state, spec.mesh, canProne and spec.collider or spec.mesh)\n            state.CustomMesh.TypeIndex = 0\n            if plain then\n                state.Description = n5Template(size, canProne, state.ColorDiffuse).Description\n            elseif rootCanProne then\n                markers[#markers+1] = {state=state, size=size}\n            end\n        elseif state.CustomMesh and N5_GEOMETRY.standeeMeshes[state.CustomMesh.MeshURL] then\n            -- Known 2D bases can be measured; asset-bundle sculpts cannot.\n            n5Mesh(state, spec.base, spec.collider)\n        end\n    end\n    normalize(object, rootSize)\n    for _, state in pairs(states) do normalize(state, rootSize) end\n\n    for sizeNumber = 0, 8 do\n        local size = tostring(sizeNumber)\n        local form = forms[size]\n        if form then\n        local spec = N5_GEOMETRY.sizes[size]\n        add(n5Template(size, form.prone, object.ColorDiffuse))\n        if form.prone then\n            local prone = n5Template(size, true, object.ColorDiffuse)\n            prone.Nickname = \"Prone SX (\" .. spec.diameter .. \" mm)\"\n            prone.Description = \"Prone: \" .. spec.diameter .. \" mm base, 3 mm high. \"\n                .. \"Use the normal model or silhouette state to stand up.\"\n            n5Mesh(prone, spec.base, spec.collider)\n            add(prone)\n        end\n    end\n    end\n    table.sort(markers, function(a,b) return a.state.Nickname < b.state.Nickname end)\n    for _, entry in ipairs(markers) do\n        local prone = deepCopy(entry.state)\n        prone.GUID, prone.States = nil, nil\n        prone.Nickname = prone.Nickname .. \" - Prone SX\"\n        -- Flatten the same UV mesh so the marker artwork survives.\n        prone.Transform.scaleY = 3 / N5_GEOMETRY.sizes[entry.size].height\n        prone.CustomMesh.ColliderURL = prone.CustomMesh.MeshURL\n        add(prone)\n    end\n    object.States = next(states) and states or nil\nend\n\n\nlocal function composeJSON(primaryJSON, alternateJSONs, silhouette, sapper,\n                           tint, sculptJSON, sectoral)\n    local object = JSON.decode(primaryJSON)\n    object.GUID = nil\n\n    -- Wear another mod's sculpt over these rules. Scale and base decals move\n    -- with it, because a sculpt built for a different scale would sit wrong if\n    -- only the model were swapped. States keep their own appearance - the\n    -- silhouette and marker templates must not be replaced by a trooper model.\n    if sculptJSON then\n        wearSculpt(object, JSON.decode(sculptJSON))\n    end\n\n    local states = object.States or {}\n    local highest = 1\n    local seenNicknames = {}\n    local coveredSizes = {}\n\n    for key, state in pairs(states) do\n        local slot = tonumber(key)\n        if slot and slot > highest then highest = slot end\n        local nickname = state.Nickname\n        if nickname then\n            seenNicknames[nickname] = true\n            addCoveredSizes(nickname, coveredSizes)\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- Alternate profiles that the mod stores as separate models rather than as\n    -- states. A few units (Chernobog, the symbiont-armour Tohaa) already have\n    -- the same form as a built-in state, so skip anything by that name.\n    for _, altJSON in ipairs(alternateJSONs) do\n        local alt = JSON.decode(altJSON)\n        alt.GUID = nil\n        if not (alt.Nickname and seenNicknames[alt.Nickname]) then\n            highest = highest + 1\n            states[tostring(highest)] = alt\n            if alt.Nickname then seenNicknames[alt.Nickname] = true end\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- Charontid's workshop IMP-2 is already a 40 mm cylinder, not S2.\n    -- Its decal was below the top, and scaling it again created an oversized copy.\n    local primaryIDs = parseIdTags(object.Description)\n    if primaryIDs and primaryIDs.unit == 498 and silhouette == \"5\" then\n        local marker\n        for _, state in pairs(states) do\n            if bareName(state.Nickname) == \"IMP-2\" then marker = state end\n        end\n        if marker then\n            marker.Transform.scaleX = 1\n            marker.Transform.scaleY = 45 / 44.45\n            marker.Transform.scaleZ = 1\n            for _, decal in ipairs(marker.AttachedDecals or {}) do\n                if (decal.CustomDecal or {}).Name == \"IMP-2\" then\n                    decal.Transform.posY = 1.755\n                end\n            end\n            local ordered = {[\"2\"] = marker}\n            local keys = {}\n            for key in pairs(states) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end\n            table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tonumber(a) < tonumber(b) end)\n            local slot = 2\n            for _, key in ipairs(keys) do\n                local state = states[key]\n                local name = bareName(state.Nickname)\n                if state ~= marker and name ~= \"Silhouette 5\"\n                        and not name:find(\"^IMP%-2\") then\n                    slot = slot + 1\n                    ordered[tostring(slot)] = state\n                end\n            end\n            states, highest = ordered, slot\n            coveredSizes[\"5\"] = true\n        end\n    end\n\n    if silhouette and not coveredSizes[silhouette]\n            and SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[silhouette] then\n        highest = highest + 1\n        states[tostring(highest)] = JSON.decode(SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[silhouette])\n        coveredSizes[silhouette] = true\n    end\n\n    -- Camo hackers whose device carries Cybermask (Killer Hacking Device,\n    -- Hacking Device Plus) can also go into IMP-2. The mod ships them with only\n    -- their camo marker, so add IMP-2 as its own state. The camo marker already\n    -- stands in for the plain silhouette, so none is added for that.\n    local rules = object.Description or \"\"\n    if rules:find(\"Camouflage\", 1, true)\n            and (rules:find(\"Killer Hacking Device\", 1, true)\n                 or rules:find(\"Hacking Device Plus\", 1, true))\n            and SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[\"IMP-2\"] then\n        local impersonates = false\n        for _, state in pairs(states) do\n            if bareName(state.Nickname):find(\"^IMP%-\") then impersonates = true end\n        end\n        if not impersonates then\n            highest = highest + 1\n            states[tostring(highest)] = JSON.decode(SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[\"IMP-2\"])\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- Sappers dig in. That needs a second silhouette at the foxhole size and a\n    -- second model whose base actually matches it - the mod ships an alternate\n    -- sculpt for most Sappers but leaves it at scale 1.0, so its base stays the\n    -- trooper's own size. We add a correctly scaled copy rather than resizing\n    -- the mod's state in place, so nothing the mod authored is altered.\n    local foxhole = sapper and foxholeSilhouette(silhouette) or nil\n    if foxhole and foxhole ~= silhouette then\n        if not coveredSizes[foxhole] and SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[foxhole] then\n            highest = highest + 1\n            states[tostring(highest)] = JSON.decode(SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[foxhole])\n            coveredSizes[foxhole] = true\n        end\n\n        local ownBase = SILHOUETTE_BASE_MM[silhouette]\n        local foxBase = SILHOUETTE_BASE_MM[foxhole]\n        if ownBase and foxBase and foxBase ~= ownBase then\n            local ratio = foxBase / ownBase\n\n            -- Prefer the mod's own alternate sculpt for this trooper: same\n            -- name as the base model but a different mesh. Otherwise reuse the\n            -- base model itself.\n            local source = object\n            local ownURL = appearanceURL(object)\n            for _, state in pairs(states) do\n                if bareName(state.Nickname) == bareName(object.Nickname)\n                        and appearanceURL(state) ~= ownURL then\n                    source = state\n                    break\n                end\n            end\n\n            local dugIn = deepCopy(source)\n            dugIn.GUID = nil\n            dugIn.States = nil\n            dugIn.Nickname = (bareName(object.Nickname) or \"\")\n                .. \" - IN FOXHOLE (S\" .. foxhole .. \")\"\n            local transform = dugIn.Transform or {}\n            transform.scaleX = (transform.scaleX or 1) * ratio\n            transform.scaleY = (transform.scaleY or 1) * ratio\n            transform.scaleZ = (transform.scaleZ or 1) * ratio\n            dugIn.Transform = transform\n\n            if not seenNicknames[dugIn.Nickname] then\n                highest = highest + 1\n                states[tostring(highest)] = dugIn\n                seenNicknames[dugIn.Nickname] = true\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- Custom miniatures also cover matching rules forms, such as Battle-Ravaged.\n    -- Marker and silhouette descriptions have no profile tags and stay untouched.\n    if sculptJSON then\n        for _, state in pairs(states) do\n            local ids = parseIdTags(state.Description)\n            if ids then\n                local key = string.format(\"%d/%d/%d\", ids.unit, ids.group, ids.option)\n                local custom = approvedSculpt(ids.unit, ids.group, sectoral, ids.profile)\n                    or CUSTOM_SCULPTS[key]\n                if custom then wearSculpt(state, JSON.decode(custom)) end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- Put transformation forms beside their corresponding silhouettes. Check\n    -- every rules form: an Intel Spec-Ops only transmutes once Enhanced.\n    local function transmutes(form)\n        return (form.Description or \"\"):lower():find(\"transmutation\", 1, true) ~= nil\n    end\n    local transforming = transmutes(object)\n    for _, state in pairs(states) do\n        if parseIdTags(state.Description) and transmutes(state) then transforming = true end\n    end\n    if transforming then\n        local ownIDs = parseIdTags(object.Description)\n        local forms, silhouettes, others = {object}, {}, {}\n        local keys = {}\n        for key in pairs(states) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end\n        table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tonumber(a) < tonumber(b) end)\n        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do\n            local state = states[key]\n            local size = bareName(state.Nickname):match(\"^Silhouette%s+(%d+)\")\n            local ids = parseIdTags(state.Description)\n            if size then\n                silhouettes[size] = silhouettes[size] or state\n            elseif ids and ownIDs and ids.unit == ownIDs.unit\n                    and ids.group == ownIDs.group then\n                forms[#forms + 1] = state\n            else\n                others[#others + 1] = state\n            end\n        end\n        if #forms > 1 then\n            local ordered, used = {}, {}\n            local function addSilhouette(size)\n                if not size or used[size] then return end\n                local state = silhouettes[size]\n                if not state and SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[size] then\n                    state = JSON.decode(SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[size])\n                end\n                -- Seed/embryo forms use a flat S0 base marker.\n                if not state and size == \"0\" and SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[\"2\"] then\n                    state = JSON.decode(SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[\"2\"])\n                    state.Nickname = \"Silhouette 0\"\n                    state.Description = \"\"\n                    state.Transform.scaleY = (state.Transform.scaleY or 1) * 3 / 40\n                end\n                if state then\n                    ordered[#ordered + 1] = state\n                    used[size] = true\n                end\n            end\n            local sizeOrder, bySize = {}, {}\n            for _, form in ipairs(forms) do\n                local size = parseSilhouette(form.Description) or \"unknown\"\n                if not bySize[size] then\n                    sizeOrder[#sizeOrder + 1] = size\n                    bySize[size] = {}\n                end\n                table.insert(bySize[size], form)\n            end\n            for _, size in ipairs(sizeOrder) do\n                for _, form in ipairs(bySize[size]) do\n                    if form ~= object then ordered[#ordered + 1] = form end\n                end\n                addSilhouette(size)\n            end\n            for _, key in ipairs(keys) do\n                local state = states[key]\n                local size = bareName(state.Nickname):match(\"^Silhouette%s+(%d+)\")\n                if size and not used[size] then addSilhouette(size) end\n            end\n            for _, state in ipairs(others) do ordered[#ordered + 1] = state end\n            states = {}\n            for i, state in ipairs(ordered) do states[tostring(i + 1)] = state end\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- Combat group tint: recolour the model and every one of its states, so\n    -- the marker/silhouette/transformation forms all stay identifiable as the\n    -- same group once swapped.\n    --\n    -- Camouflage and Silhouette states already carry the model's own colour,\n    -- but the mod hardcodes the impersonation markers to fixed colours - IMP-2\n    -- a pink, IMP-1 a light blue - the same on every unit regardless of\n    -- faction. A cybermasked trooper should still read as yours, so those get\n    -- brought in line with the combat group tint, or with the model's own\n    -- colour when the group is left on \"Faction\".\n    local ownColour = object.ColorDiffuse\n    if tint then\n        object.ColorDiffuse = { r = tint.r, g = tint.g, b = tint.b }\n    end\n\n    local fallback = tint or ownColour\n    -- Profile names follow the same selected colour as their bases.\n    -- Keep marker labels unchanged: their prefixes identify special states.\n    local function colourProfileName(profile, colour)\n        if not colour or not parseIdTags(profile.Description) then return end\n        local function channel(value)\n            return math.floor(math.max(0, math.min(1, value)) * 255 + 0.5)\n        end\n        local tag = string.format(\"[%02X%02X%02X]\",\n            channel(colour.r), channel(colour.g), channel(colour.b))\n        local nickname = profile.Nickname or \"\"\n        if nickname:find(\"^%[%x%x%x%x%x%x%]\") then\n            -- Replace only the opening colour: the mod's reset marks the end\n            -- of the unit name, leaving loadout text in its original style.\n            profile.Nickname = nickname:gsub(\"^%[%x%x%x%x%x%x%]\", tag, 1)\n        else\n            profile.Nickname = tag .. nickname .. \"[-]\"\n        end\n    end\n    colourProfileName(object, fallback)\n    for _, state in pairs(states) do\n        if fallback then\n            state.ColorDiffuse = { r = fallback.r, g = fallback.g, b = fallback.b }\n        end\n        colourProfileName(state, fallback)\n    end\n\n    -- An empty table would serialise as [] and confuse TTS, so only attach\n    -- States when there is actually something in it.\n    if next(states) ~= nil then\n        object.States = states\n    else\n        object.States = nil\n    end\n\n    if N5_GEOMETRY then normalizeN5(object, silhouette) end\n    return JSON.encode(object)\nend\n\n-- --------------------------------------------------------- Team-Ops picks --\n\n-- Spec-Ops and Team-Ops troopers take rows from their unit's table: BS +1,\n-- ARM +1 with Dogged, Albedo, a Contender, ... ARMY writes the chosen rows\n-- into the code as raw attributes. ARMY applies them to every profile of the\n-- trooper, so they go onto the card of every rules form, and onto the name.\nlocal PICK_STATS = {cc = {\"CC\"}, bs = {\"BS\"}, ph = {\"PH\"}, wip = {\"WIP\"},\n                    arm = {\"ARM\"}, bts = {\"BTS\"}, s = {\"S\"},\n                    w = {\"V\", \"STR\", \"W\"}}\nlocal PICK_SECTIONS = {\n    weapon = \"[ffdddd][sub]----------Weapons---------\\n[/sub]\\n\",\n    equip  = \"[ddffdd][sub]---------Equipment--------\\n[/sub]\\n\",\n    skill  = \"[ddddff][sub]----------Skills ---------\\n[/sub]\\n\",\n}\nlocal PICK_ORDER = {\"weapon\", \"equip\", \"skill\"}\n\nlocal function pickInches(cm)\n    local value = cm / 2.5\n    if value == math.floor(value) then return string.format(\"%d\", value) end\n    return string.format(\"%g\", value)\nend\n\nlocal function pickName(attr)\n    if type(attr)~=\"table\" then return nil end\n    local names = TEAMOPS_NAMES[attr.type]\n    local name = names and names[tonumber(attr.id) or attr.id]\n    if not name then return nil end\n    local extras = {}\n    local modifiers=attr.extra or attr.extras or {}\n    if type(modifiers)~=\"table\" then modifiers={modifiers} end\n    for _, extra in ipairs(modifiers) do\n        local id = type(extra) == \"table\" and extra.id or extra\n        extras[#extras + 1] = TEAMOPS_NAMES.extra[tonumber(id) or id] or (\"modifier #\"..tostring(id))\n    end\n    if #extras > 0 then name = name .. \"(\" .. table.concat(extras, \", \") .. \")\" end\n    if attr.type == \"skill\" and tonumber(attr.q) and tonumber(attr.q) ~= 1 then\n        name = string.format(\"%dx %s\", tonumber(attr.q), name)\n    end\n    return name\nend\n\n--- Add one entry to a card section, opening the section if the profile has\n--- none (2,000-odd profiles carry no Equipment line at all).\nlocal function addToSection(description, kind, name)\n    local header = PICK_SECTIONS[kind]\n    local s, e = description:find(header, 1, true)\n    if s then\n        local stop = description:find(\"\\n\", e + 1, true) or (#description + 1)\n        local line = description:sub(e + 1, stop - 1)\n        if line:lower():find(name:lower(), 1, true) then return description end\n        local body = line:match(\"^(.-)%[%-%]$\")\n        line = body and (body .. TEAMOPS_SEPARATOR .. name .. \"[-]\")\n            or (line .. TEAMOPS_SEPARATOR .. name)\n        return description:sub(1, e) .. line .. description:sub(stop)\n    end\n    -- Sections run Weapons, Equipment, Skills; the ID tags are the last line.\n    local at, later = nil, false\n    for _, other in ipairs(PICK_ORDER) do\n        if other == kind then\n            later = true\n        elseif later and not at then\n            at = description:find(PICK_SECTIONS[other], 1, true)\n        end\n    end\n    local lastLine = description:match(\".*()\\n\")\n    at = at or (lastLine and lastLine + 1) or (#description + 1)\n    return description:sub(1, at - 1) .. header .. name .. \"[-]\\n\"\n        .. description:sub(at)\nend\n\nlocal function bumpStat(description, labels, q)\n    for _, label in ipairs(labels) do\n        local pattern = \"(%[[Bb]%]\" .. label .. \"%[/[Bb]%]:%s*)(%d+)\"\n        if description:find(pattern) then\n            return (description:gsub(pattern, function(prefix, value)\n                return prefix .. string.format(\"%d\", tonumber(value) + q)\n            end, 1))\n        end\n    end\n    return description\nend\n\nlocal function setMove(description, index, cm)\n    return (description:gsub(\"(%[[Bb]%]MOV%[/[Bb]%]:%s*)(%d+)%-(%d+)\",\n        function(prefix, first, second)\n            if index == 0 then first = pickInches(cm) else second = pickInches(cm) end\n            return prefix .. first .. \"-\" .. second\n        end, 1))\nend\n\n--- The chosen rows from a member's `spectables`, each a list of attributes.\nlocal function pickRows(spectables)\n    local rows = {}\n    if type(spectables)~=\"table\" then return rows end\n    for _, item in ipairs(spectables and spectables.items or {}) do\n        local raw=type(item)==\"table\" and item.attrs or nil\n        local ok, attrs = true, raw\n        if type(raw)==\"string\" then ok,attrs=pcall(JSON.decode,raw) end\n        if ok and type(attrs) == \"table\" and #attrs > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = attrs end\n    end\n    return rows\nend\n\nlocal function applyPicksUnchecked(json, spectables)\n    local rows = pickRows(spectables)\n    if #rows == 0 then return json end\n    local object = JSON.decode(json)\n    local function applyTo(profile)\n        local d = profile.Description or \"\"\n        for _, attrs in ipairs(rows) do\n            for _, attr in ipairs(attrs) do\n                if attr.type == \"stat\" and (attr.stat == \"move0\" or attr.stat == \"move1\") then\n                    if attr.q then d = setMove(d, attr.stat == \"move0\" and 0 or 1, attr.q) end\n                elseif attr.type == \"stat\" then\n                    local labels = PICK_STATS[attr.stat]\n                    if labels and attr.q then d = bumpStat(d, labels, attr.q) end\n                elseif PICK_SECTIONS[attr.type] then\n                    local name = pickName(attr)\n                    if name then d = addToSection(d, attr.type, name) end\n                end\n            end\n        end\n        profile.Description = d\n    end\n\n    -- One short label per row, the way ARMY lists them: \"ARM +1, Dogged\".\n    local labels = {}\n    applyTo(object)\n    for _, attrs in ipairs(rows) do\n        local moved = false\n        for _, attr in ipairs(attrs) do\n            if attr.type == \"stat\" and (attr.stat == \"move0\" or attr.stat == \"move1\") then\n                if not moved then\n                    moved = true\n                    local move = object.Description:match(\"%[[Bb]%]MOV%[/[Bb]%]:%s*(%d+%-%d+)\")\n                    if move then labels[#labels + 1] = \"MOV \" .. move end\n                end\n            elseif attr.type == \"stat\" and PICK_STATS[attr.stat] and attr.q then\n                labels[#labels + 1] = string.format(\"%s %s%d\", PICK_STATS[attr.stat][1],\n                    attr.q > 0 and \"+\" or \"\", attr.q)\n            else\n                labels[#labels + 1] = pickName(attr)\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    local suffix = #labels > 0 and (\" + \" .. table.concat(labels, \", \")) or \"\"\n    object.Nickname = (object.Nickname or \"\") .. suffix\n    for _, state in pairs(object.States or {}) do\n        if parseIdTags(state.Description) then\n            applyTo(state)\n            state.Nickname = (state.Nickname or \"\") .. suffix\n        end\n    end\n    return JSON.encode(object)\nend\n\n-- Team Ops upgrades must never prevent the base model from being created.\nlocal function normalizedPicks(picks)\n    local result={items={}}\n    local warnings={}\n    if type(picks)~='table' then return result,{'Upgrade data is not a table; upgrades were not applied.'} end\n    local items=picks.items or picks\n    if type(items)~='table' then return result,{'Upgrade rows are invalid; upgrades were not applied.'} end\n    for _,item in ipairs(items) do\n        local raw=type(item)=='table' and item.attrs or nil\n        local ok,attrs=true,raw\n        if type(raw)=='string' then ok,attrs=pcall(JSON.decode,raw) end\n        if ok and type(attrs)=='table' then\n            if attrs.type then attrs={attrs} end\n            local row={}\n            for _,attr in ipairs(attrs) do\n                if type(attr)~='table' then\n                    warnings[#warnings+1]='Invalid upgrade attribute was skipped.'\n                else\n                    local a=deepCopy(attr)\n                    a.id=tonumber(a.id) or a.id\n                    if a.q~=nil then\n                        local n=tonumber(a.q)\n                        if not n or n~=n or n==math.huge or n==-math.huge or n~=math.floor(n) then\n                            warnings[#warnings+1]='Invalid upgrade quantity for '..tostring(a.stat or a.id)..'; skipped.'\n                            a=nil\n                        else a.q=n end\n                    end\n                    if a then\n                        if a.type=='stat' then\n                            if not (PICK_STATS[a.stat] or a.stat=='move0' or a.stat=='move1') or a.q==nil then\n                                warnings[#warnings+1]='Unsupported stat upgrade '..tostring(a.stat)..'; not applied.'\n                                a=nil\n                            end\n                        elseif not PICK_SECTIONS[a.type] or not pickName(a) then\n                            warnings[#warnings+1]='Unsupported '..tostring(a.type)..' upgrade #'..tostring(a.id)..'; not applied.'\n                            a=nil\n                        elseif a.extra or a.extras then\n                            local mods=a.extra or a.extras\n                            if type(mods)~='table' then mods={mods} end\n                            for _,mod in ipairs(mods) do\n                                local id=type(mod)=='table' and mod.id or mod\n                                if not TEAMOPS_NAMES.extra[tonumber(id) or id] then\n                                    warnings[#warnings+1]='Unknown modifier #'..tostring(id)..'; shown by ID for review.'\n                                end\n                            end\n                        end\n                        if a then row[#row+1]=a end\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n            if #row>0 then result.items[#result.items+1]={attrs=JSON.encode(row)} end\n        else warnings[#warnings+1]='Could not read an upgrade row; that row was not applied.' end\n    end\n    return result,warnings\nend\n\nlocal function refreshUpgradedSilhouettes(object,oldSizes,warnings)\n    local states=object.States or {}\n    local sizes={}\n    local changed=false\n    local function gather(form)\n        if parseIdTags(form.Description) then\n            local size=parseSilhouette(form.Description)\n            if size then sizes[size]=true end\n            local old=oldSizes[form.Nickname or '']\n            if old and size and old~=size then\n                changed=true\n                local ratio=SILHOUETTE_BASE_MM[size] and SILHOUETTE_BASE_MM[old]\n                    and SILHOUETTE_BASE_MM[size]/SILHOUETTE_BASE_MM[old]\n                if ratio then\n                    form.Transform=form.Transform or {}\n                    for _,axis in ipairs({'scaleX','scaleY','scaleZ'}) do\n                        form.Transform[axis]=(form.Transform[axis] or 1)*ratio\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    gather(object)\n    for _,state in pairs(states) do gather(state) end\n    if not changed then return end\n    local kept={}\n    for _,state in pairs(states) do\n        local name=bareName(state.Nickname)\n        if not name:match('^Silhouette
