%d+$') and not name:match('^Prone SX')\n                and not name:match(' %- Prone SX$') then kept[#kept+1]=state end\n    end\n    local ordered={}\n    for size in pairs(sizes) do ordered[#ordered+1]=size end\n    table.sort(ordered)\n    for _,size in ipairs(ordered) do\n        if SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[size] then\n            local state=JSON.decode(SILHOUETTE_TEMPLATES[size])\n            state.ColorDiffuse=deepCopy(object.ColorDiffuse)\n            kept[#kept+1]=state\n        else warnings[#warnings+1]='No silhouette template for upgraded S'..size..'; check the footprint.' end\n    end\n    object.States={}\n    for i,state in ipairs(kept) do object.States[tostring(i+1)]=state end\n    if N5_GEOMETRY then normalizeN5(object,parseSilhouette(object.Description)) end\nend\n\nlocal function applyPicks(json,picks)\n    local normalized,warnings=normalizedPicks(picks)\n    local ok,result=pcall(applyPicksUnchecked,json,normalized)\n    if not ok then\n        warnings[#warnings+1]='Upgrade import failed; original profile retained. '..tostring(result)\n        result=json\n    else\n        local before=JSON.decode(json)\n        local after=JSON.decode(result)\n        local sizes={}\n        sizes[before.Nickname or '']=parseSilhouette(before.Description)\n        for _,state in pairs(before.States or {}) do sizes[state.Nickname or '']=parseSilhouette(state.Description) end\n        -- Upgrade suffixes change names, so map sizes to the new names too.\n        sizes[after.Nickname or '']=parseSilhouette(before.Description)\n        for key,state in pairs(after.States or {}) do\n            local previous=(before.States or {})[key]\n            if previous then sizes[state.Nickname or '']=parseSilhouette(previous.Description) end\n        end\n        local safe,err=pcall(refreshUpgradedSilhouettes,after,sizes,warnings)\n        if not safe then warnings[#warnings+1]='Could not rebuild upgraded silhouette: '..tostring(err) end\n        if #warnings>0 then\n            after.GMNotes=(after.GMNotes or '')..'\\nTEAM OPS IMPORT WARNINGS:\\n'..table.concat(warnings,'\\n')\n        end\n        result=JSON.encode(after)\n    end\n    return result,warnings\nend\n\nlocal function upgradedMinelayer(resolved)\n    if not resolved.picks then return nil end\n    local picks=normalizedPicks(resolved.picks)\n    local count,chosen=0,nil\n    local modelForWeapon={[62]=11,[63]=16,[174]=4,[196]=13,[197]=7,[199]=1}\n    local modelForEquip={[111]=12,[243]=6}\n    for _,attrs in ipairs(pickRows(picks)) do\n        for _,attr in ipairs(attrs) do\n            if attr.type=='skill' and attr.id==56 then count=count+(attr.q or 1) end\n            if attr.type=='weapon' and modelForWeapon[attr.id] then chosen=modelForWeapon[attr.id] end\n            if attr.type=='equip' and modelForEquip[attr.id] then chosen=modelForEquip[attr.id] end\n        end\n    end\n    if count==0 then return nil end\n    if not chosen then\n        local base=JSON.decode(expandModelJSON(resolved.primary.template))\n        local d=base.Description or ''\n        local names={{'Shock Mine',13},{'AP Mine',1},{'E/M Mine',7},{'Viral Mine',16},\n            {'Monofilament Mine',11},{'Cybermine',4},{'CyberMine',4},{'Deployable Repeater',12},{'Dazer',6}}\n        for _,entry in ipairs(names) do if d:find(entry[1],1,true) then chosen=entry[2];break end end\n    end\n    if chosen then return {model=chosen,count=count} end\n    return nil\nend\n\n-- Identical content hashes from still-working copies in the credited source.\nlocal ASSET_REPAIRS={\n ['https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1549759048735385892/4B24FB6529C6093D9BEFD81A24DB60047E5323C8/']='https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2005828631758831508/4B24FB6529C6093D9BEFD81A24DB60047E5323C8/',\n ['https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1549759048735414555/E3A8F794605E598D8E44C81C86C202FA4D4064FC/']='https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2005828631758732243/E3A8F794605E598D8E44C81C86C202FA4D4064FC/',\n UNAVAILABLE_DECALS={\n ['https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1468687989852435033/95F3EA9E9B7EDC697885B20D045064EA8EAD968F/']=true,\n ['https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1468687989852472116/918706022C5575AC2FADCDF2726A66C3704F1204/']=true,\n ['https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1685996137035386996/2719A30F5688D4C8DA31327F9A32D90A5836387D/']=true,\n}\nfunction repairAssetReferences(json)\n    local object=JSON.decode(json)\n    local function repair(v)\n        if type(v)~='table' then return end\n        if v.AttachedDecals then\n            local kept={}\n            for _,decal in ipairs(v.AttachedDecals) do\n                if not UNAVAILABLE_DECALS[(decal.CustomDecal or {}).ImageURL] then kept[#kept+1]=decal end\n            end\n            v.AttachedDecals=#kept>0 and kept or nil\n        end\n        for k,w in pairs(v) do\n            if type(w)=='string' and ASSET_REPAIRS[w] then v[k]=ASSET_REPAIRS[w]\n            elseif type(w)=='table' then repair(w) end\n        end\n    end\n    repair(object)\n    return JSON.encode(object)\nend\n\n-- Exact purchased loadout and sectorial only: never use a sculpt's skills or\n-- the public hidden-option twin. The API carries both native and hired IDs.\nlocal function minelayerRule(resolved)\n    return upgradedMinelayer(resolved) or MINELAYER_LOADOUTS[tostring(resolved.approvalSectoral) .. \"/\"\n        .. (resolved.requestedKey or resolved.key)]\nend\n\nlocal function spawnMinelayerDeployables(resolved, positions, tint)\n    local rule = minelayerRule(resolved)\n    if not rule then return end\n    local template = DEPLOYABLE_MODELS[rule.model]\n    if not template then return end\n    for i = 1, rule.count do\n        local object = JSON.decode(template)\n        if tint then\n            object.ColorDiffuse = {r=tint.r, g=tint.g, b=tint.b}\n            for _, state in pairs(object.States or {}) do\n                state.ColorDiffuse = {r=tint.r, g=tint.g, b=tint.b}\n            end\n        end\n        spawnObjectJSON({json=JSON.encode(object), position=positions[i]})\n    end\nend\n\n-- All inputs that affect public appearance/rules, after hidden-option remaps.\n-- Length prefixes avoid delimiter collisions without another JSON conversion.\n-- Purchased IDs are deliberately absent: peripherals/deployables are handled\n-- separately for each purchase, even when their parent models look identical.\nlocal function preparedModelKey(primary, alternates, silhouette, sapper, tint, sculpt, sectoral)\n    local colour = tint and string.format(\"%.17g/%.17g/%.17g\", tint.r, tint.g, tint.b) or \"faction\"\n    local parts = {primary, tostring(silhouette), tostring(sapper), colour,\n                   sculpt or \"\", tostring(sectoral), sculptMode, tostring(#alternates)}\n    for _, alternate in ipairs(alternates) do parts[#parts + 1] = alternate end\n    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do parts[i] = #part .. \":\" .. part end\n    return table.concat(parts)\nend\n\nlocal function spawnResolved(resolved, position, label, tint, playerColor,\n                             onDone, prepared)\n    local callerDone=onDone\n    local completed=false\n    onDone=function(success)\n        if completed then return end\n        completed=true\n        callerDone(success)\n    end\n    withModelJSON(resolved.primary, function(primaryJSON)\n        if not primaryJSON then\n            printToPlayer(\"Could not take \" .. label .. \" from its bag.\",\n                          playerColor, CHAT.error)\n            return onDone()\n        end\n\n        local alternateJSONs, sculptJSON = {}, nil\n        local function finish()\n            local key = prepared and preparedModelKey(primaryJSON, alternateJSONs,\n                resolved.primary.silhouette, resolved.primary.sapper, tint,\n                sculptJSON, resolved.approvalSectoral)\n            local json = key and prepared.entries[key]\n            if not json then\n                json = composeJSON(primaryJSON, alternateJSONs,\n                    resolved.primary.silhouette, resolved.primary.sapper, tint,\n                    sculptJSON, resolved.approvalSectoral)\n                -- Session-local strings only. Discarded when this army's queue\n                -- releases its closures; never shared across later spawns.\n                if key and prepared.count < 128\n                        and prepared.bytes + #key + #json <= 2 * 1024 * 1024 then\n                    prepared.entries[key] = json\n                    prepared.count = prepared.count + 1\n                    prepared.bytes = prepared.bytes + #key + #json\n                end\n            end\n            -- After the shared cache: two Chandras may take different rows.\n            if resolved.picks then\n                local warnings\n                json,warnings=applyPicks(json,resolved.picks)\n                for _,warning in ipairs(warnings) do printToPlayer(label..\": \"..warning,playerColor,CHAT.warn) end\n            end\n            json=repairAssetReferences(json)\n            local finished=false\n            local timeout\n            local function complete(success)\n                if finished then return end\n                finished=true\n                if timeout and Wait.stop then Wait.stop(timeout) end\n                onDone(success)\n            end\n            if Wait.time then timeout=Wait.time(function()\n                printToPlayer(\"Timed out waiting for \"..label..\" to spawn.\",playerColor,CHAT.error)\n                complete(false)\n            end,60) end\n            local ok,result=pcall(spawnObjectJSON,{\n                json=json,position=position,\n                callback_function=function(object) complete(object~=nil) end,\n            })\n            if not ok or not result then\n                printToPlayer(\"Could not spawn \"..label..\": \"..tostring(result),playerColor,CHAT.error)\n                complete(false)\n            end\n        end\n\n        -- Fetch the borrowed sculpt (if any), then each alternate profile,\n        -- then build the object. Every fetch is a bag take/return round trip,\n        -- so they run one after another rather than concurrently.\n        local function withSculpt(next)\n            if resolved.customSculpt then\n                sculptJSON = resolved.customSculpt\n                return next()\n            end\n            -- The pack is already JSON, so this costs nothing. Only a sculpt\n            -- borrowed from a live bag needs a take/return round trip.\n            if resolved.packSculpt then\n                sculptJSON = SCULPT_APPEARANCES[resolved.packSculpt]\n                return next()\n            end\n            if not resolved.sculpt then return next() end\n            withModelJSON(resolved.sculpt, function(json)\n                sculptJSON = json\n                next()\n            end)\n        end\n\n        withSculpt(function()\n            local index = 0\n            local function nextAlternate()\n                index = index + 1\n                if index > #resolved.alternates then\n                    local ok,err=pcall(finish)\n                    if not ok then\n                        printToPlayer(\"Model preparation failed for \"..label..\": \"..tostring(err),playerColor,CHAT.error)\n                        onDone(false)\n                    end\n                    return\n                end\n                withModelJSON(resolved.alternates[index], function(altJSON)\n                    if altJSON then\n                        alternateJSONs[#alternateJSONs + 1] = altJSON\n                    end\n                    nextAlternate()\n                end)\n            end\n            nextAlternate()\n        end)\n    end)\nend\n\n-- ----------------------------------------------------------- main action --\n\nlocal lastCode = \"\"\n\nlocal function stripTint(nickname)\n    return (nickname:gsub(\"%[%x%x%x%x%x%x%]\", \"\"):gsub(\"%[%-%]\", \"\"))\nend\n\n-- The snapshot omits these TAG-specific copies of shared ancillary bots.\n-- Only use the equivalent bot when the requested peripheral is unavailable.\nlocal PERIPHERAL_FALLBACKS = {\n    [\"500/2/1\"] = \"1624/2/1\", -- Avatar: Caskuda's Staldron\n    [\"785/2/1\"] = \"1624/2/1\", -- Overdron: Caskuda's Staldron\n    [\"420/2/1\"] = \"1580/2/1\", -- Szalamandra: Gator's Robbybot\n    [\"399/2/1\"] = \"1580/2/1\", -- Lizard: Robbybot\n    [\"1735/2/1\"] = \"1580/2/1\", -- Reinforcement Lizard: Robbybot\n    [\"1647/2/1\"] = \"1651/2/1\", -- Reinforcement Squalos Mk-II: matching Crabbot\n    [\"1618/2/1\"] = \"1624/2/1\", -- Reinforcement Caskuda: Staldron\n    [\"1668/2/1\"] = \"1552/2/1\", -- Reinforcement Rasail: Chaksa Peripheral\n    [\"1530/2/1\"] = \"1609/2/1\", -- Lawkeeper: Roadbot's Sidebot\n}\n\nlocal function spawnArmy(code, playerColor)\n    queueFailed = false\n    local army, err = decodeArmyCode(code)\n    if not army then\n        broadcastToPlayer(\"Army code error: \" .. tostring(err), playerColor,\n                          CHAT.error)\n        return\n    end\n\n    -- Reuse the static index and unchanged live bags. Metadata checks still\n    -- pick up bags brought into the scene since the previous spawn.\n    buildIndex()\n    if indexedCount == 0 then\n        broadcastToPlayer(\n            \"No tagged Infinity models found in this scene. Load the \" ..\n            \"'Infinity the Game - Models' mod (or bring its faction bags in) \" ..\n            \"and try again.\", playerColor, CHAT.error)\n        return\n    end\n\n    local narrate = true\n    local total = 0\n    for _, group in ipairs(army.groups) do total = total + #group.members end\n\n    if chatReport then\n        report(string.format(\n            \"%s  %s  (%d pts, %d models across %d combat group%s)\",\n            army.factionName,\n            army.armyName ~= \"\" and army.armyName or \"unnamed list\",\n            army.maxPoints, total, #army.groups, #army.groups == 1 and \"\" or \"s\"),\n            CHAT.header)\n    end\n    if army.warning then report(army.warning, CHAT.stale) end\n\n    local missing, spawnedCount, statefulCount = {}, 0, 0\n    local failedCount=0\n    local remappedCount, peripheralCount = 0, 0\n    local sculptCount, staleCount = 0, 0\n    -- `inexact` names every model that is not wearing a sculpt of its own\n    -- exact loadout, whichever way it fell short. Left empty in 2D mode, where\n    -- that is the whole point rather than a shortfall.\n    local proxyCount, packCount, standInCount, inexact = 0, 0, 0, {}\n    local refusedCount = 0    -- stand-ins this mode turned down\n    local numGroups = #army.groups\n    local frontGap = firstRowOffset()\n    -- Snapshot the layout before any asynchronous jobs. Troops, deployables\n    -- and the HVT stay together even if the tool moves while they spawn.\n    local layout = {origin=self.getPosition(), right=self.getTransformRight(),\n                    forward=self.getTransformForward(), yaw=self.getRotation().y}\n    local prepared = {entries={}, bytes=0, count=0}\n\n    for groupSlot, group in ipairs(army.groups) do\n        local rowIndex, colIndex = 0, 0\n        local palette = PALETTE[groupColorIdx[groupSlot] or 1] or PALETTE[1]\n        local tint = palette.color\n\n        --- Claim the next grid slot in this group's block.\n        local function nextPosition()\n            if colIndex >= CONFIG.perRow then\n                colIndex = 0\n                rowIndex = rowIndex + 1\n            end\n            local position = layoutPosition(groupSlot, numGroups,\n                                            rowIndex, colIndex, frontGap, layout)\n            colIndex = colIndex + 1\n            return position\n        end\n\n        local function place(resolved)\n            local position = nextPosition()\n            -- Claim deployable slots now, before asynchronous spawn jobs run.\n            -- They follow their owner through the same grid and row wrapping.\n            local deployablePositions = {}\n            local rule = minelayerRule(resolved)\n            if rule then\n                for i = 1, rule.count do deployablePositions[i] = nextPosition() end\n            end\n            local label = stripTint(resolved.primary.nickname)\n            -- Count only after TTS confirms creation.\n            if narrate then\n                if #resolved.alternates > 0 then\n                    statefulCount = statefulCount + 1\n                end\n                if resolved.customSculpt then\n                    sculptCount = sculptCount + 1\n                elseif resolved.sculpt then\n                    sculptCount = sculptCount + 1\n                    if resolved.sculptProxy then\n                        proxyCount = proxyCount + 1\n                        inexact[#inexact + 1] = label ..\n                            \"   (proxy: \" .. stripTint(resolved.sculpt.nickname) .. \")\"\n                    end\n                elseif resolved.packSculpt then\n                    sculptCount = sculptCount + 1\n                    packCount = packCount + 1\n                    if resolved.standIn then\n                        standInCount = standInCount + 1\n                        inexact[#inexact + 1] = label ..\n                            \"   (stand-in: \" .. resolved.standIn .. \")\"\n                    elseif resolved.packInexact then\n                        -- The pack knows this is the right trooper but not that it\n                        -- is the right weapon, and cannot name what it did pick -\n                        -- the two mods number the loadouts differently.\n                        proxyCount = proxyCount + 1\n                        inexact[#inexact + 1] = label .. \"   (proxy: another loadout)\"\n                    end\n                elseif sculptMode ~= \"2d\" then\n                    if resolved.standInRefused then\n                        refusedCount = refusedCount + 1\n                        inexact[#inexact + 1] = label ..\n                            \"   (no sculpt; 3D FORCE would use \" ..\n                            resolved.standInRefused .. \")\"\n                    else\n                        inexact[#inexact + 1] = label .. \"   (no sculpt)\"\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n            if resolved.primary.edition == 4 then\n                staleCount = staleCount + 1\n            end\n            enqueue(function(done)\n                spawnResolved(resolved, position, label, tint, playerColor,\n                    function(success)\n                        if success then\n                            spawnedCount=spawnedCount+1\n                            spawnMinelayerDeployables(resolved,deployablePositions,tint)\n                        else failedCount=failedCount+1 end\n                        done()\n                    end, prepared)\n            end)\n        end\n\n        --- An includes-table key (\"unit/group/option\") as a member table.\n        local function keyMember(pKey)\n            local u, g, o = pKey:match(\"^(%d+)/(%d+)/(%d+)$\")\n            if not u then return nil end\n            return { unit = tonumber(u), group = tonumber(g),\n                     option = tonumber(o) }\n        end\n\n        --- Spawn a resolved entry plus everything its option brings along -\n        --- Crabbots, K-9 Antipodes, Scarface's Turtlemek - into the next\n        --- slots of the same group, same tint. Peripheral lookups run on\n        --- resolved.key, which resolveMember has already folded to the id\n        --- the build-time tables spell mercenaries with.\n        local function spawnWithRetinue(resolved)\n            if resolved.remapped then\n                remappedCount = remappedCount + 1\n            end\n            place(resolved)\n\n            local peripherals = UNIT_PERIPHERALS[resolved.key]\n                or (resolved.remapped\n                    and UNIT_PERIPHERALS[OPTION_REMAP[resolved.key]])\n            for _, pKey in ipairs(peripherals or {}) do\n                local m = keyMember(pKey)\n                local pResolved = m and resolveMember(m, army.sectoral)\n                if not pResolved and PERIPHERAL_FALLBACKS[pKey] then\n                    pResolved = resolveMember(keyMember(PERIPHERAL_FALLBACKS[pKey]), army.sectoral)\n                end\n                if pResolved then\n                    peripheralCount = peripheralCount + 1\n                    place(pResolved)\n                else\n                    missing[#missing + 1] = string.format(\n                        \"peripheral %s (of %s)\", pKey,\n                        stripTint(resolved.primary.nickname))\n                end\n            end\n        end\n\n        for _, member in ipairs(group.members) do\n            local resolved = resolveMember(member, army.sectoral)\n\n            if resolved then\n                -- Only the purchased trooper: its retinue takes no table rows.\n                resolved.picks = member.spectables\n                spawnWithRetinue(resolved)\n            else\n                -- Units bought together - Jazz & Billie, Margot & Duroc, the\n                -- Zondnautica - are one entry in the code, written as group\n                -- 0: the unit's own option list rather than a profile group.\n                -- That option has no model of its own; its includes ARE the\n                -- troopers. So a key that resolves to nothing but has an\n                -- includes entry is a container, and each member it names\n                -- spawns as a full trooper, bringing its own retinue -\n                -- Scarface's Turtlemek hangs off his profile-group option,\n                -- not off the team entry.\n                local team = UNIT_PERIPHERALS[\n                    lookupKey(member.unit, member.group, member.option)]\n                if not team and member.unit >= 10000 then\n                    team = UNIT_PERIPHERALS[lookupKey(\n                        member.unit - 10000, member.group, member.option)]\n                end\n\n                if team and member.group == 0 then\n                    for _, pKey in ipairs(team) do\n                        local m = keyMember(pKey)\n                        local tResolved = m and resolveMember(m, army.sectoral)\n                        if tResolved then\n                            tResolved.picks=member.spectables\n                            spawnWithRetinue(tResolved)\n                        else\n                            missing[#missing + 1] = string.format(\n                                \"team member %s (of unit %d / option %d)\",\n                                pKey, member.unit, member.option)\n                        end\n                    end\n                else\n                    missing[#missing + 1] = string.format(\n                        \"%sunit %d / group %d / option %d (list: %s)\",\n                        member.spectables and \"Team Ops \" or \"\", member.unit, member.group,\n                        member.option,army.armyName)\n                    if member.spectables then\n                        printToPlayer(\"Team Ops profile not found. Keep this Army code and report the IDs below; no different profile was substituted.\",playerColor,CHAT.error)\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- Capture the selected pool before the queued spawn.\n    local armyHVTs = hvtPool()\n    -- Only successful army spawns get an HVT; invalid/empty lists get none.\n    if #armyHVTs > 0 then\n        enqueue(function(done)\n            if spawnedCount>0 then spawnRandomHVT(numGroups, frontGap, layout, armyHVTs) end\n            done()\n        end)\n    end\n\n    enqueue(function(done)\n        local showReport = narrate and chatReport\n        -- Parentheses around the mode label, never square brackets: \"[2D]\"\n        -- is exactly the token TTS's chat parser eats as a truncated colour\n        -- tag, which is what made the dice roller unreadable (see CHAT).\n        if showReport then\n            local summary = string.format(\"Spawned %d model%s (%s).\",\n                spawnedCount, spawnedCount == 1 and \"\" or \"s\", sculptModeLabel())\n            if spawnedCount > 0 and #armyHVTs > 0 then\n                summary = summary .. \" Added one random HVT.\"\n            end\n            if peripheralCount > 0 then\n                summary = summary .. string.format(\n                    \" That includes %d peripheral%s.\", peripheralCount,\n                    peripheralCount == 1 and \"\" or \"s\")\n            end\n            if sculptCount > 0 then\n                summary = summary .. string.format(\n                    \" %d wear%s a 3D sculpt\", sculptCount,\n                    sculptCount == 1 and \"s\" or \"\")\n                local notes = {}\n                if packCount > 0 then\n                    notes[#notes + 1] = string.format(\n                        \"%d from the built-in pack\", packCount)\n                end\n                if proxyCount > 0 then\n                    notes[#notes + 1] = string.format(\n                        \"%d a different loadout of the same trooper\", proxyCount)\n                end\n                if standInCount > 0 then\n                    notes[#notes + 1] = string.format(\n                        \"%d standing in for someone else\", standInCount)\n                end\n                if #notes > 0 then\n                    summary = summary .. \" (\" .. table.concat(notes, \", \") .. \")\"\n                end\n                summary = summary .. \".\"\n            end\n            if statefulCount > 0 then\n                summary = summary .. string.format(\n                    \" %d ha%s alternate profiles on right-click states.\",\n                    statefulCount, statefulCount == 1 and \"s\" or \"ve\")\n            end\n            report(summary, CHAT.good)\n        end\n\n        -- Which options were hidden-info stand-ins is private, so it goes to\n        -- the player who pressed the button, not the whole table.\n        if showReport and remappedCount > 0 then\n            printToPlayer(string.format(\n                \"%d hidden-info option%s (LT, Chain of Command, ...) \" ..\n                \"spawned as the identical public profile, unmarked.\",\n                remappedCount, remappedCount == 1 and \"\" or \"s\"),\n                playerColor, CHAT.note)\n        end\n\n        -- Stale rules are worse than a missing model, because the numbers on\n        -- the card look plausible but are wrong. Said even with the report\n        -- muted, to the player whose models they are.\n        if staleCount > 0 then\n            printToPlayer(string.format(\n                \"%d model%s only available with N4-era stats. Load the \" ..\n                \"'Infinity the Game - Models' bags for current N5 rules.\",\n                staleCount, staleCount == 1 and \" was\" or \"s were\"),\n                playerColor, CHAT.stale)\n        end\n\n        -- The only moment both mods are loaded is right now. If this army is\n        -- about to be saved as an object and carried into a multiplayer\n        -- session, anything not wearing its own sculpt has to be swapped\n        -- before that - so name them while it can still be acted on. Part of\n        -- the chat report, though: it is advice, not an error.\n        if #inexact > 0 then\n            printToPlayer(string.format(\n                \"%d model%s not sculpted for this exact loadout:\",\n                #inexact, #inexact == 1 and \" is\" or \"s are\"),\n                playerColor, CHAT.detail)\n            for i, entry in ipairs(inexact) do\n                if i > SCULPT_REPORT_LIMIT then\n                    printToPlayer(string.format(\"   ... and %d more.\",\n                        #inexact - SCULPT_REPORT_LIMIT), playerColor,\n                        CHAT.detail)\n                    break\n                end\n                printToPlayer(\"   \" .. entry, playerColor, CHAT.detail)\n            end\n            if refusedCount > 0 then\n                printToPlayer(string.format(\n                    \"   %d of those could be 3D on 3D FORCE, wearing \" ..\n                    \"another trooper's sculpt.\", refusedCount),\n                    playerColor, CHAT.detail)\n            end\n        end\n\n        if failedCount>0 then\n            printToPlayer(string.format(\"Spawned %d models; %d failed. Check the warnings above.\",spawnedCount,failedCount),playerColor,CHAT.error)\n        end\n        if #missing > 0 then\n            printToPlayer(string.format(\n                \"%d entr%s had no matching model in the loaded bags:\",\n                #missing, #missing == 1 and \"y\" or \"ies\"),\n                playerColor, CHAT.warn)\n            for _, entry in ipairs(missing) do\n                printToPlayer(\"   \" .. entry, playerColor, CHAT.warn)\n            end\n        end\n        done()\n    end)\nend\n\n\n-- ------------------------------------------------------------- callbacks --\n\nfunction onCodeInput(_, _, value)\n    lastCode = value or \"\"\nend\n\nfunction onSpawnClick(_, playerColor)\n    if spawnBusy or queueRunning then\n        printToPlayer(\"An army is already spawning.
